ko.title: 숫자로 보는 할로윈: 사탕, 의상, 장식이 소비자 신뢰도에 대해 말해주는 것

segments.src: Every October, a familiar question returns to the retail world: how much are Americans willing to spend on a holiday that is, by almost any definition, optional?
segments.tr: 매년 10월이 되면 소매업계에는 친숙한 질문이 돌아온다. 거의 모든 정의에 따르면 선택사항인 명절에 미국인들은 과연 얼마를 기꺼이 지출할 것인가?

segments.src: Halloween has no gift obligations, no family travel and no formal dinner.
segments.tr: 할로윈에는 선물 의무도 없고, 가족 여행도 없으며, 형식적인 저녁 식사도 없다.

segments.src: That is precisely why economists and retail analysts watch it.
segments.tr: 바로 이것이 경제학자와 소매 분석가들이 할로윈을 주시하는 이유이다.

segments.src: When households feel secure, the candy aisle and the costume rack tend to show it.
segments.tr: 가계가 안정감을 느낄 때 사탕 진열대와 의상 걸이는 대개 그것을 보여준다.

segments.src: When budgets tighten, those same categories are often among the first places shoppers trim.
segments.tr: 예산이 빠듯해지면 바로 그 품목들이 쇼퍼들이 가장 먼저 줄이는 곳 중 하나가 된다.

segments.src: ## Why Halloween Is a Useful Barometer
segments.tr: ## 할로윈이 유용한 풍향계인 이유

segments.src: Halloween sits in a distinctive spot on the calendar.
segments.tr: 할로윈은 달력상에서 독특한 위치를 차지하고 있다.

segments.src: It arrives before the peak of holiday shopping, which makes it an early read on the mood of the consumer heading into the busiest months of the retail year.
segments.tr: 연말 쇼핑 성수기보다 앞서 찾아오기 때문에, 소매업 연중 가장 바쁜 시기로 접어드는 소비자의 심리를 조기에 파악할 수 있게 해준다.

segments.src: Spending is also highly discretionary and spread across many price points, from a bag of fun-size candy to an elaborate yard display.
segments.tr: 또한 지출은 성격상 재량에 크게 좌우되며 한 봉지의 소형 사탕부터 정교한 마당 장식까지 다양한 가격대에 걸쳐 분산되어 있다.

segments.src: Trade groups such as the National Retail Federation publish an annual forecast based on consumer surveys, and in recent years those projections have repeatedly pointed to historically high totals.
segments.tr: 전미소매연맹(National Retail Federation) 같은 무역 단체들은 소비자 설문조사를 바탕으로 연간 전망치를 발표하며, 최근 몇 년간 이러한 전망은 역사적으로 높은 총액을 거듭 가리켜 왔다.

segments.src: A headline number alone, however, can mislead.
segments.tr: 그러나 헤드라인 수치만 보면 오해를 살 수 있다.

segments.src: Rising prices mean that even a flat unit volume can show up as higher dollar spending.
segments.tr: 물가 상승은 판매 물량에 변함이 없더라도 더 높은 달러 지출로 나타날 수 있음을 의미한다.

segments.src: The more informative signals are in the details: what people buy, how much of it, and where they buy it.
segments.tr: 더 유익한 신호는 세부 사항에 있다. 사람들이 무엇을 사는지, 얼마나 사는지, 어디서 사는지 말이다.

segments.src: ## Candy: The Staple That Absorbs Price Pressure
segments.tr: ## 사탕: 가격 압박을 흡수하는 필수품

segments.src: Candy is the core of the holiday and the category most households treat as non-negotiable.
segments.tr: 사탕은 명절의 핵심이자 대부분의 가계가 타협할 수 없는 품목으로 취급하는 카테고리이다.

segments.src: Parents and neighbors who hand out treats rarely skip the purchase altogether.
segments.tr: 간식을 나누어 주는 부모와 이웃들은 구매 자체를 아예 건너뛰는 경우가 드문 편이다.

segments.src: Instead, behavior tends to change at the margins:
segments.tr: 대신 행동은 주변부에서 바뀌는 경향이 있다:

segments.src: - **Smaller bags or fewer varieties.** Shoppers who once bought several brands may settle on one or two.
segments.tr: - **더 작은 봉지 또는 더 적은 종류.** 한때 여러 브랜드를 구매했던 쇼퍼들은 한두 가지로 안주할 수 있다.

segments.src: - **Store brands and bulk packs.** Value-oriented purchases tend to gain share when grocery bills rise.
segments.tr: - **유통업체 자체 브랜드 및 대용량 팩.** 식료품비가 오를 때 가성비 위주의 구매는 점유율을 얻는 경향이 있다.

segments.src: - **Earlier or later buying.** Some households shop early to catch promotions; others wait for clearance pricing in the final days.
segments.tr: - **더 이른 또는 더 늦은 구매.** 프로모션을 잡기 위해 일찍 쇼핑하는 가계가 있는가 하면, 마지막 날들의 재고 정리를 기다리는 가계도 있다.

segments.src: Cocoa and sugar costs, along with packaging and transportation expenses, have been cited by manufacturers as pressures on chocolate pricing in recent seasons.
segments.tr: 코코아와 설탕 비용은 포장 및 운송 비용과 함께 최근 시즌 초콜릿 가격에 압박을 주는 요인으로 제조업체들에 의해 언급되어 왔다.

segments.src: For consumers, the practical result is that the same budget buys somewhat less, which can shape how many trick-or-treaters a household feels it can comfortably serve.
segments.tr: 소비자 관점에서 실질적인 결과는 동일한 예산으로 다소 적게 구매하게 된다는 점이며, 이는 가계가 편안하게 맞이할 수 있다고 느끼는 사탕 받으러 오는 아이들의 수를 결정하는 데 영향을 미칠 수 있다.

segments.src: ## Costumes: Where Choices Get More Selective
segments.tr: ## 의상: 선택이 더욱 까다로워지는 곳

segments.src: Costumes are the most discretionary part of the holiday, and they offer the clearest window into how shoppers weigh a small luxury against everyday costs.
segments.tr: 의상은 명절에서 가장 재량적인 부분이며, 쇼퍼들이 작은 사치와 일상 비용을 어떻게 저울질하는지 보여주는 가장 명확한 창구를 제공한다.

segments.src: Several patterns tend to appear when budgets are under strain:
segments.tr: 예산이 압박을 받을 때 몇 가지 패턴이 나타나는 경향이 있다:

segments.src: - **Reuse and swapping.** Families pass costumes among siblings, friends and neighbors.
segments.tr: - **재사용 및 교환.** 가족들은 형제자매, 친구, 이웃 간에 의상을 물려준다.

segments.src: - **Do-it-yourself looks.** Assembling an outfit from items already in the closet is a popular way to cut costs.
segments.tr: - **직접 만들기.** 옷장에 이미 있는 아이템으로 옷을 조합하는 것은 비용을 절감하는 인기 있는 방법이다.

segments.src: - **Secondhand and resale options.** Thrift stores and online marketplaces see more traffic as the holiday approaches.
segments.tr: - **중고 및 재판매 옵션.** 명절이 다가올수록 중고 매장과 온라인 마켓플레이스는 더 많은 트래픽을 기록한다.

segments.src: - **Pets and children first.** Many households protect spending on kids' costumes while cutting back on their own.
segments.tr: - **반려동물과 아이들 우선.** 많은 가계가 자신들의 지출은 줄이면서 아이들의 의상 지출은 보호한다.

segments.src: Because costume trends often follow popular films, shows and games, retailers also face inventory risk.
segments.tr: 의상 트렌드는 인기 영화, 쇼, 게임을 따르는 경우가 많기 때문에 소매업체들은 재고 위험에도 직면하게 된다.

segments.src: A character that surges in popularity can sell out quickly, while a miss leaves shelves full of discounted stock.
segments.tr: 인기가 급상승하는 캐릭터는 빠르게 매진될 수 있는 반면, 인기가 없는 캐릭터는 할인된 재고가 선반에 가득 남게 된다.

segments.src: ## Decorations: A Measure of Confidence in the Home
segments.tr: ## 장식: 가정의 신뢰도를 가늠하는 척도

segments.src: Decorations are the category that most clearly separates comfortable budgets from cautious ones.
segments.tr: 장식은 편안한 예산과 신중한 예산을 가장 명확하게 구분해 주는 카테고리이다.

segments.src: Large inflatables, lighting and themed props can be expensive, and they are durable enough that many people choose to reuse last year's collection.
segments.tr: 대형 공기 주입식 장식, 조명, 테마 소품은 비용이 많이 들 수 있지만, 작년 컬렉션을 다시 사용하는 사람들이 많을 정도로 내구성이 충분하다.

segments.src: When shoppers feel optimistic, they are more likely to add new pieces.
segments.tr: 쇼퍼들이 낙관적일 때 새로운 피스를 추가할 가능성이 더 높다.

segments.src: When they are uncertain, they tend to refresh a few items instead of buying a full display.
segments.tr: 불확실할 때는 전체 디스플레이를 구매하는 대신 몇 가지 아이템을 새로 고치는 경향이 있다.

segments.src: The growth of Halloween as a season rather than a single night has also shaped this category.
segments.tr: 단하루의 밤이 아니라 시즌으로서 할로윈의 성장은 이 카테고리 또한 형성해 왔다.

segments.src: Retailers now stock seasonal merchandise earlier, and some consumers begin decorating weeks in advance.
segments.tr: 소매업체들은 이제 계절 상품을 더 일찍 입고하며, 일부 소비자는 몇 주 앞서 장식을 시작하기도 한다.

segments.src: That longer window gives households more time to compare prices, wait for sales and spread purchases across several paychecks.
segments.tr: 이러한 더 긴 기간은 가계가 가격을 비교하고, 세일을 기다리며, 여러 번의 급여일에 걸쳐 구매를 분산할 수 있는 시간을 더 많이 제공한다.

segments.src: ## How Inflation Shapes the Basket
segments.tr: ## 인플레이션이 장바구니를 형성하는 방식

segments.src: Inflation does not simply raise the total; it changes the composition of what people buy.
segments.tr: 인플레이션은 단순히 총액을 끌어올리는 것이 아니라 사람들이 구매하는 것의 구성을 바꾼다.

segments.src: A few dynamics are worth keeping in mind when reading any seasonal forecast:
segments.tr: 계절별 전망을 읽을 때 염두에 둘 가치가 있는 몇 가지 역학 관계가 있다:

segments.src: 1. **Nominal versus real spending.** A record dollar figure may reflect higher prices rather than more goods.
segments.tr: 1. **명목 지출 대 실질 지출.** 기록적인 달러 수치는 더 많은 상품보다는 더 높은 물가를 반영할 수 있다.

segments.src: 2. **Trading down.** Shoppers often move toward lower-priced brands or retailers, which can shift where the money goes even if the total holds steady.
segments.tr: 2. **가격대 낮추기(Trading down).** 쇼퍼들은 종종 더 저렴한 브랜드나 유통업체로 이동하며, 이는 총액이 일정하게 유지되더라도 돈이 어디로 가는지 바꿀 수 있다.

segments.src: 3. **Uneven effects by income.** Higher-income households may maintain or increase spending, while lower-income households make visible cuts. Averages can hide that split.
segments.tr: 3. **소득별 불균등한 영향.** 소득이 높은 가계는 지출을 유지하거나 늘릴 수 있는 반면, 소득이 낮은 가계는 눈에 띄게 지출을 줄인다. 평균은 그러한 분열을 가릴 수 있다.

segments.src: 4. **Credit and timing.** Some purchases are shifted to cards or to buy-now-pay-later options, which affects how comfortable spending actually is.
segments.tr: 4. **신용과 시기.** 일부 구매는 카드나 선구매-후결제(buy-now-pay-later) 옵션으로 이동하며, 이는 실제 지출이 얼마나 편안한지에 영향을 미친다.

segments.src: ## What to Watch for the Rest of the Season
segments.tr: ## 남은 시즌 동안 주목해야 할 점

segments.src: Halloween is only one data point, but it is an early one.
segments.tr: 할로윈은 단 하나의 데이터 포인트에 불과하지만, 이른 데이터 포인트이다.

segments.src: Analysts will be looking at how final sales compare with the forecasts, whether promotional activity picks up in the last week, and how much merchandise is left over for post-holiday clearance.
segments.tr: 분석가들은 최종 판매가 전망치와 어떻게 비교되는지, 마지막 주에 프로모션 활동이 활발해지는지, 명절 후 정리를 위해 얼마나 많은 상품이 남아 있는지 살펴볼 것이다.

segments.src: Heavy discounting after October 31 often suggests retailers misjudged demand, while thin clearance racks may indicate stronger-than-expected buying.
segments.tr: 10월 31일 이후의 과도한 할인은 종종 소매업체들이 수요를 오판했음을 시사하는 반면, 얇은 정리 선반은 예상보다 강한 구매를 나타낼 수 있다.

segments.src: For households, the lesson is practical rather than predictive.
segments.tr: 가계 입장에서 이 교훈은 예측적이라기보다는 실용적이다.

segments.src: Setting a firm budget in advance, comparing unit prices on candy, borrowing or reusing costumes and mixing new decorations with old ones can keep the holiday enjoyable without straining finances.
segments.tr: 사전에 확고한 예산을 세우고, 사탕의 단위 가격을 비교하며, 의상을 빌리거나 재사용하고, 새로운 장식을 오래된 것들과 섞는 것은 재정에 무리를 주지 않으면서 명절을 즐겁게 유지할 수 있게 해준다.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: Halloween spending is not a perfect gauge of the economy, and forecasts are estimates that can be revised.
segments.tr: 할로윈 지출은 경제를 완벽하게 가늠하는 척도가 아니며, 전망치는 수정될 수 있는 추정치이다.

segments.src: Still, the holiday offers a useful, human-scale look at how people are balancing small pleasures against rising costs.
segments.tr: 그럼에도 불구하고 이 명절은 사람들이 상승하는 비용에 맞서 작은 즐거움을 어떻게 조율하고 있는지 유용하고 인간적인 규모의 시각을 제공한다.

segments.src: This year, the story is less about whether Americans will celebrate and more about how they choose to do it: carefully, selectively and, in many cases, creatively.
segments.tr: 올해의 이야기는 미국인들이 축하할 것인가의 여부보다는 신중하게, 선택적으로, 그리고 많은 경우 창의적으로 어떻게 축하하기로 선택하는가에 더 가깝다.

segments.tr: *이 기사는 일반적인 정보 제공 목적으로만 제공되며 재정적 또는 투자적 조언을 구성하지 않는다.

segments.src: Figures and forecasts referenced are general in nature; readers should consult current reports from official or industry sources for the latest data.*
segments.tr: 참조된 수치와 전망치는 성격상 일반적이므로 독자는 최신 데이터를 위해 공식 또는 산업 소스의 최신 보고서를 참조해야 한다.*

zh.title: 万圣节数字揭示：糖果、服装和装饰品如何反映消费者信心

segments.src: Every October, a familiar question returns to the retail world: how much are Americans willing to spend on a holiday that is, by almost any definition, optional?
segments.tr: 每年十月，零售界都会迎来一个熟悉的问题：美国人愿意在一个几乎所有定义下都是“可有可无”的节日上花多少钱？

segments.src: Halloween has no gift obligations, no family travel and no formal dinner.
segments.tr: 万圣节没有送礼义务，没有家庭旅行，也没有正式晚宴。

segments.src: That is precisely why economists and retail analysts watch it.
segments.tr: 这正是经济学家和零售分析师关注它的原因。

segments.src: When households feel secure, the candy aisle and the costume rack tend to show it.
segments.tr: 当家庭感到安心时，糖果货架和服装架往往会体现出来。

segments.src: When budgets tighten, those same categories are often among the first places shoppers trim.
segments.tr: 当预算收紧时，这些相同的类别往往是购物者最先削减的地方。

segments.src: ## Why Halloween Is a Useful Barometer
segments.tr: ## 为什么万圣节是一个有用的晴雨表

segments.src: Halloween sits in a distinctive spot on the calendar.
segments.tr: 万圣节在日历上占据着独特的位置。

segments.src: It arrives before the peak of holiday shopping, which makes it an early read on the mood of the consumer heading into the busiest months of the retail year.
segments.tr: 它在假日购物高峰之前到来，这使其成为进入零售一年中最忙碌几个月前消费者情绪的早期晴雨表。

segments.src: Spending is also highly discretionary and spread across many price points, from a bag of fun-size candy to an elaborate yard display.
segments.tr: 支出也高度可自由支配，并且分布在许多价格点上，从一袋趣味装糖果到精心布置的庭院陈设。

segments.src: Trade groups such as the National Retail Federation publish an annual forecast based on consumer surveys, and in recent years those projections have repeatedly pointed to historically high totals.
segments.tr: 全国零售联合会等行业组织根据消费者调查发布年度预测，近年来这些预测一再指向历史最高总额。

segments.src: A headline number alone, however, can mislead.
segments.tr: 然而，仅凭头条数字可能会产生误导。

segments.src: Rising prices mean that even a flat unit volume can show up as higher dollar spending.
segments.tr: 价格上涨意味着即使单位销量持平，也会表现为更高的美元支出。

segments.src: The more informative signals are in the details: what people buy, how much of it, and where they buy it.
segments.tr: 更有信息的信号在于细节：人们买什么、买多少以及在哪里买。

segments.src: ## Candy: The Staple That Absorbs Price Pressure
segments.tr: ## 糖果：吸收价格压力的主打商品

segments.src: Candy is the core of the holiday and the category most households treat as non-negotiable.
segments.tr: 糖果是节日的基石，也是大多数家庭认为不可妥协的品类。

segments.src: Parents and neighbors who hand out treats rarely skip the purchase altogether.
segments.tr: 分发糖果的父母和邻居很少完全跳过购买。

segments.src: Instead, behavior tends to change at the margins:
segments.tr: 相反，行为往往在边缘发生变化：

segments.src: - **Smaller bags or fewer varieties.** Shoppers who once bought several brands may settle on one or two.
segments.tr: - **更小的包装或更少的品种。** 曾经购买几个品牌的购物者可能会满足于一个或两个。

segments.src: - **Store brands and bulk packs.** Value-oriented purchases tend to gain share when grocery bills rise.
segments.tr: - **商店自有品牌和散装包。** 当杂货账单上涨时，以价值为导向的购买往往会获得市场份额。

segments.src: - **Earlier or later buying.** Some households shop early to catch promotions; others wait for clearance pricing in the final days.
segments.tr: - **更早或更晚购买。** 一些家庭提早购物以赶上促销；另一些则等待最后几天的清仓价格。

segments.src: Cocoa and sugar costs, along with packaging and transportation expenses, have been cited by manufacturers as pressures on chocolate pricing in recent seasons.
segments.tr: 制造商指出，可可和糖的成本以及包装和运输费用是近年来巧克力定价的压力所在。

segments.src: For consumers, the practical result is that the same budget buys somewhat less, which can shape how many trick-or-treaters a household feels it can comfortably serve.
segments.tr: 对消费者而言，实际结果是同样的预算买到的东西略少，这会影响一个家庭觉得可以舒适招待多少个讨糖的孩子。

segments.src: ## Costumes: Where Choices Get More Selective
segments.tr: ## 服装：选择变得更有选择性地方

segments.src: Costumes are the most discretionary part of the holiday, and they offer the clearest window into how shoppers weigh a small luxury against everyday costs.
segments.tr: 服装是节日中最具可自由支配的部分，它们为了解购物者如何在日常成本中权衡小奢侈品提供了最清晰的窗口。

segments.src: Several patterns tend to appear when budgets are under strain:
segments.tr: 预算紧张时往往会出现几种模式：

segments.src: - **Reuse and swapping.** Families pass costumes among siblings, friends and neighbors.
segments.tr: - **重复使用和交换。** 家庭在兄弟姐妹、朋友和邻居之间传递服装。

segments.src: - **Do-it-yourself looks.** Assembling an outfit from items already in the closet is a popular way to cut costs.
segments.tr: - **自己动手造型。** 用衣柜里已有的物品组装一套服装是削减成本的流行方式。

segments.src: - **Secondhand and resale options.** Thrift stores and online marketplaces see more traffic as the holiday approaches.
segments.tr: - **二手和转售选择。** 随着节日临近，旧货店和在线市场的流量增加。

segments.src: - **Pets and children first.** Many households protect spending on kids' costumes while cutting back on their own.
segments.tr: - **宠物和儿童优先。** 许多家庭在保护儿童服装支出的同时削减了自己的开支。

segments.src: Because costume trends often follow popular films, shows and games, retailers also face inventory risk.
segments.tr: 由于服装潮流往往跟随热门电影、节目和游戏，零售商也面临库存风险。

segments.src: A character that surges in popularity can sell out quickly, while a miss leaves shelves full of discounted stock.
segments.tr: 人气飙升的角色可以迅速售罄，而失误则会留下一货架打折库存。

segments.src: ## Decorations: A Measure of Confidence in the Home
segments.tr: ## 装饰品：衡量家庭信心的指标

segments.src: Decorations are the category that most clearly separates comfortable budgets from cautious ones.
segments.tr: 装饰品是最能将舒适预算与谨慎预算区分开来的品类。

segments.src: Large inflatables, lighting and themed props can be expensive, and they are durable enough that many people choose to reuse last year's collection.
segments.tr: 大型充气玩具、灯光和主题道具可能很昂贵，而且它们足够耐用，以至于许多人选择重复使用去年的藏品。

segments.src: When shoppers feel optimistic, they are more likely to add new pieces.
segments.tr: 当购物者感到乐观时，他们更有可能添加新作品。

segments.src: When they are uncertain, they tend to refresh a few items instead of buying a full display.
segments.tr: 当他们不确定时，他们往往会刷新几个项目，而不是购买完整的展示。

segments.src: The growth of Halloween as a season rather than a single night has also shaped this category.
segments.tr: 万圣节作为一个季节而不是一个晚上的增长也塑造了这一品类。

segments.src: Retailers now stock seasonal merchandise earlier, and some consumers begin decorating weeks in advance.
segments.tr: 零售商现在更早地进货季节性商品，一些消费者提前数周开始装饰。

segments.src: That longer window gives households more time to compare prices, wait for sales and spread purchases across several paychecks.
segments.tr: 这个更长的窗口期让家庭有更多时间比较价格、等待销售并在多个发薪日分摊购买。

segments.src: ## How Inflation Shapes the Basket
segments.tr: ## 通货膨胀如何塑造购物篮

segments.src: Inflation does not simply raise the total; it changes the composition of what people buy.
segments.tr: 通货膨胀不仅提高了总额；它改变了人们购买的组成。

segments.src: A few dynamics are worth keeping in mind when reading any seasonal forecast:
segments.tr: 在阅读任何季节性预测时，有几个动态值得牢记：

segments.src: 1. **Nominal versus real spending.** A record dollar figure may reflect higher prices rather than more goods.
segments.tr: 1. **名义支出与实际支出。** 创纪录的美元数字可能反映了价格上涨，而不是更多的商品。

segments.src: 2. **Trading down.** Shoppers often move toward lower-priced brands or retailers, which can shift where the money goes even if the total holds steady.
segments.tr: 2. **降级消费。** 购物者经常转向价格较低的品牌或零售商，即使总额保持稳定，这也可能改变资金的去向。

segments.src: 3. **Uneven effects by income.** Higher-income households may maintain or increase spending, while lower-income households make visible cuts. Averages can hide that split.
segments.tr: 3. **按收入划分的不均衡影响。** 高收入家庭可能会维持或增加支出，而低收入家庭则会明显削减。平均值可以隐藏这种分裂。

segments.src: 4. **Credit and timing.** Some purchases are shifted to cards or to buy-now-pay-later options, which affects how comfortable spending actually is.
segments.tr: 4. **信用和时间。** 一些购买被转移到信用卡或先买后付的选项，这会影响支出的实际舒适度。

segments.src: ## What to Watch for the Rest of the Season
segments.tr: ## 季节剩余时间要注意什么

segments.src: Halloween is only one data point, but it is an early one.
segments.tr: 万圣节只是一个数据点，但它是一个早期的点。

segments.src: Analysts will be looking at how final sales compare with the forecasts, whether promotional activity picks up in the last week, and how much merchandise is left over for post-holiday clearance.
segments.tr: 分析师将关注最终销售额与预测的对比情况、促销活动是否在最后一周回升，以及有多少商品留给节后清仓。

segments.src: Heavy discounting after October 31 often suggests retailers misjudged demand, while thin clearance racks may indicate stronger-than-expected buying.
segments.tr: 10月31日之后的大幅折扣通常表明零售商对需求判断失误，而薄薄的清仓货架可能表明购买力强于预期。

segments.src: For households, the lesson is practical rather than predictive.
segments.tr: 对于家庭来说，教训是实用的而不是预测性的。

segments.src: Setting a firm budget in advance, comparing unit prices on candy, borrowing or reusing costumes and mixing new decorations with old ones can keep the holiday enjoyable without straining finances.
segments.tr: 提前设定坚实的预算、比较糖果的单位价格、借用或重复使用服装以及将新装饰品与旧装饰品混合可以保持节日愉快而又不会拉紧财务。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 底线

segments.src: Halloween spending is not a perfect gauge of the economy, and forecasts are estimates that can be revised.
segments.tr: 万圣节支出并不是经济的完美晴雨表，预测是可以修改的估计。

segments.src: Still, the holiday offers a useful, human-scale look at how people are balancing small pleasures against rising costs.
segments.tr: 尽管如此，该节日提供了一个有用且人性化的视角，展示了人们如何在小快乐与不断上涨的成本之间取得平衡。

segments.src: This year, the story is less about whether Americans will celebrate and more about how they choose to do it: carefully, selectively and, in many cases, creatively.
segments.tr: 今年，这个故事与其说是美国人是否会庆祝，不如说是他们选择如何庆祝：小心翼翼、有选择性地，并且在许多情况下充满创意。

hi.title: संख्याओं में हैलोवीन: कैंडी, वेशभूषा और सजावट उपभोक्ता विश्वास के बारे में क्या बताती है

segments.src: Every October, a familiar question returns to the retail world: how much are Americans willing to spend on a holiday that is, by almost any definition, optional?
segments.tr: हर अक्टूबर में, खुदरा दुनिया में एक परिचित सवाल लौट आता है: अमेरिकी एक ऐसे त्योहार पर कितना खर्च करने को तैयार हैं जो, लगभग किसी भी परिभाषा के अनुसार, वैकल्पिक है?

segments.src: Halloween has no gift obligations, no family travel and no formal dinner.
segments.tr: हैलोवीन में उपहार देने की कोई बाध्यता नहीं है, कोई पारिवारिक यात्रा नहीं है और कोई औपचारिक रात्रिभोज नहीं है।

segments.src: That is precisely why economists and retail analysts watch it.
segments.tr: यही कारण है कि अर्थशास्त्री और खुदरा विश्लेषक इस पर नज़र रखते हैं।

segments.src: When households feel secure, the candy aisle and the costume rack tend to show it.
segments.tr: जब परिवार सुरक्षित महसूस करते हैं, तो कैंडी की गलियारे और वेशभूषा के रैक इसे दर्शाते हैं।

segments.src: When budgets tighten, those same categories are often among the first places shoppers trim.
segments.tr: जब बजट तंग होता है, तो वही श्रेणियां अक्सर उन पहली जगहों में से होती हैं जहाँ खरीदार कटौती करते हैं।

segments.src: ## Why Halloween Is a Useful Barometer
segments.tr: ## हैलोवीन एक उपयोगी बैरोमीटर क्यों है

segments.src: Halloween sits in a distinctive spot on the calendar.
segments.tr: हैलोवीन कैलेंडर पर एक विशिष्ट स्थान पर स्थित है।

segments.src: It arrives before the peak of holiday shopping, which makes it an early read on the mood of the consumer heading into the busiest months of the retail year.
segments.tr: यह छुट्टियों की खरीदारी के चरम से पहले आता है, जो इसे खुदरा वर्ष के सबसे व्यस्त महीनों में उपभोक्ता के मूड को समझने का एक शुरुआती संकेत बनाता है।

segments.src: Spending is also highly discretionary and spread across many price points, from a bag of fun-size candy to an elaborate yard display.
segments.tr: खर्च भी अत्यधिक विवेकाधीन है और कई मूल्य बिंदुओं पर फैला हुआ है, फन-साइज कैंडी के एक बैग से लेकर आंगन की विस्तृत सजावट तक।

segments.src: Trade groups such as the National Retail Federation publish an annual forecast based on consumer surveys, and in recent years those projections have repeatedly pointed to historically high totals.
segments.tr: नेशनल रिटेल फेडरेशन जैसे व्यापार समूह उपभोक्ता सर्वेक्षणों के आधार पर एक वार्षिक पूर्वानुमान प्रकाशित करते हैं, और हाल के वर्षों में उन अनुमानों ने बार-बार ऐतिहासिक रूप से उच्च कुल खर्च की ओर इशारा किया है।

segments.src: A headline number alone, however, can mislead.
segments.tr: हालाँकि, केवल एक मुख्य संख्या गुमराह कर सकती है।

segments.src: Rising prices mean that even a flat unit volume can show up as higher dollar spending.
segments.tr: बढ़ती कीमतों का मतलब है कि स्थिर मात्रा भी अधिक डॉलर खर्च के रूप में दिखाई दे सकती है।

segments.src: The more informative signals are in the details: what people buy, how much of it, and where they buy it.
segments.tr: अधिक जानकारीपूर्ण संकेत विवरणों में हैं: लोग क्या खरीदते हैं, कितना खरीदते हैं, और वे इसे कहाँ से खरीदते हैं।

segments.src: ## Candy: The Staple That Absorbs Price Pressure
segments.tr: ## कैंडी: वह मुख्य वस्तु जो मूल्य के दबाव को सोख लेती है

segments.src: Candy is the core of the holiday and the category most households treat as non-negotiable.
segments.tr: कैंडी इस त्योहार का मूल है और वह श्रेणी है जिसे अधिकांश परिवार गैर-परक्राम्य मानते हैं।

segments.src: Parents and neighbors who hand out treats rarely skip the purchase altogether.
segments.tr: माता-पिता और पड़ोसी जो मिठाइयाँ बाँटते हैं, वे शायद ही कभी खरीदारी को पूरी तरह छोड़ते हैं।

segments.src: Instead, behavior tends to change at the margins:
segments.tr: इसके बजाय, व्यवहार हाशिए पर बदलने लगता है:

segments.src: - **Smaller bags or fewer varieties.** Shoppers who once bought several brands may settle on one or two.
segments.tr: - **छोटे बैग या कम किस्में।** जो खरीदार कभी कई ब्रांड खरीदते थे, वे एक या दो पर समझौता कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **Store brands and bulk packs.** Value-oriented purchases tend to gain share when grocery bills rise.
segments.tr: - **स्टोर ब्रांड और थोक पैक।** जब किराने का बिल बढ़ता है तो मूल्य-उन्मुख खरीदारी का हिस्सा बढ़ने लगता है।

segments.src: - **Earlier or later buying.** Some households shop early to catch promotions; others wait for clearance pricing in the final days.
segments.tr: - **जल्दी या देर से खरीदारी।** कुछ परिवार प्रमोशन का लाभ उठाने के लिए जल्दी खरीदारी करते हैं; अन्य अंतिम दिनों में क्लीयरेंस मूल्य का इंतजार करते हैं।

segments.src: Cocoa and sugar costs, along with packaging and transportation expenses, have been cited by manufacturers as pressures on chocolate pricing in recent seasons.
segments.tr: कोको और चीनी की लागत, पैकेजिंग और परिवहन खर्चों के साथ, निर्माताओं द्वारा हाल के मौसमों में चॉकलेट की कीमतों पर दबाव के रूप में उद्धृत की गई है।

segments.src: For consumers, the practical result is that the same budget buys somewhat less, which can shape how many trick-or-treaters a household feels it can comfortably serve.
segments.tr: उपभोक्ताओं के लिए, व्यावहारिक परिणाम यह है कि समान बजट में कुछ कम सामान आता है, जो यह तय कर सकता है कि एक परिवार कितने 'ट्रिक-ऑर-ट्रीटर्स' की सेवा आराम से कर सकता है।

segments.src: ## Costumes: Where Choices Get More Selective
segments.tr: ## वेशभूषा: जहाँ विकल्प अधिक चयनात्मक हो जाते हैं

segments.src: Costumes are the most discretionary part of the holiday, and they offer the clearest window into how shoppers weigh a small luxury against everyday costs.
segments.tr: वेशभूषा त्योहार का सबसे विवेकाधीन हिस्सा है, और वे इस बात की सबसे स्पष्ट झलक प्रदान करते हैं कि खरीदार दैनिक लागतों के मुकाबले छोटी विलासिता को कैसे तौलते हैं।

segments.src: Several patterns tend to appear when budgets are under strain:
segments.tr: जब बजट पर दबाव होता है तो कई पैटर्न दिखाई देने लगते हैं:

segments.src: - **Reuse and swapping.** Families pass costumes among siblings, friends and neighbors.
segments.tr: - **पुन: उपयोग और अदला-बदली।** परिवार भाई-बहनों, दोस्तों और पड़ोसियों के बीच वेशभूषा साझा करते हैं।

segments.src: - **Do-it-yourself looks.** Assembling an outfit from items already in the closet is a popular way to cut costs.
segments.tr: - **स्वयं तैयार करना (DIY)।** अलमारी में पहले से मौजूद चीजों से पोशाक तैयार करना लागत कम करने का एक लोकप्रिय तरीका है।

segments.src: - **Secondhand and resale options.** Thrift stores and online marketplaces see more traffic as the holiday approaches.
segments.tr: - **सेकंडहैंड और पुनर्विक्रय विकल्प।** जैसे-जैसे त्योहार नजदीक आता है, थ्रिफ्ट स्टोर और ऑनलाइन मार्केटप्लेस पर ट्रैफिक बढ़ जाता है।

segments.src: - **Pets and children first.** Many households protect spending on kids' costumes while cutting back on their own.
segments.tr: - **पालतू जानवर और बच्चे पहले।** कई परिवार बच्चों की वेशभूषा पर खर्च सुरक्षित रखते हैं जबकि अपने खर्च में कटौती करते हैं।

segments.src: Because costume trends often follow popular films, shows and games, retailers also face inventory risk.
segments.tr: चूंकि वेशभूषा के रुझान अक्सर लोकप्रिय फिल्मों, शो और खेलों का अनुसरण करते हैं, इसलिए खुदरा विक्रेताओं को इन्वेंट्री जोखिम का भी सामना करना पड़ता है।

segments.src: A character that surges in popularity can sell out quickly, while a miss leaves shelves full of discounted stock.
segments.tr: एक चरित्र जो लोकप्रियता में उछाल लाता है, वह जल्दी बिक सकता है, जबकि एक असफल चरित्र अलमारियों को रियायती स्टॉक से भर देता है।

segments.src: ## Decorations: A Measure of Confidence in the Home
segments.tr: ## सजावट: घर में विश्वास का एक पैमाना

segments.src: Decorations are the category that most clearly separates comfortable budgets from cautious ones.
segments.tr: सजावट वह श्रेणी है जो आरामदायक बजट को सतर्क बजट से सबसे स्पष्ट रूप से अलग करती है।

segments.src: Large inflatables, lighting and themed props can be expensive, and they are durable enough that many people choose to reuse last year's collection.

segments.src: ## How Inflation Shapes the Basket
segments.tr: ## मुद्रास्फीति बास्केट को कैसे आकार देती है

segments.src: Inflation does not simply raise the total; it changes the composition of what people buy.

es.title: Halloween en cifras: lo que los dulces, los disfraces y las decoraciones revelan sobre la confianza del consumidor

segments.src: Every October, a familiar question returns to the retail world: how much are Americans willing to spend on a holiday that is, by almost any definition, optional?
segments.tr: Cada octubre, una pregunta familiar regresa al mundo minorista: ¿cuánto están dispuestos a gastar los estadounidenses en una festividad que es, bajo casi cualquier definición, opcional?

segments.src: Halloween has no gift obligations, no family travel and no formal dinner.
segments.tr: Halloween no tiene obligaciones de regalos, ni viajes familiares, ni cenas formales.

segments.src: That is precisely why economists and retail analysts watch it.
segments.tr: Esa es precisamente la razón por la que los economistas y analistas minoristas lo observan.

segments.src: When households feel secure, the candy aisle and the costume rack tend to show it.
segments.tr: Cuando los hogares se sienten seguros, el pasillo de los dulces y el estante de los disfraces tienden a demostrarlo.

segments.src: When budgets tighten, those same categories are often among the first places shoppers trim.
segments.tr: Cuando los presupuestos se ajustan, esas mismas categorías suelen estar entre los primeros lugares donde los compradores recortan gastos.

segments.src: ## Why Halloween Is a Useful Barometer
segments.tr: ## Por qué Halloween es un barómetro útil

segments.src: Halloween sits in a distinctive spot on the calendar.
segments.tr: Halloween ocupa un lugar distintivo en el calendario.

segments.src: It arrives before the peak of holiday shopping, which makes it an early read on the mood of the consumer heading into the busiest months of the retail year.
segments.tr: Llega antes del pico de las compras navideñas, lo que lo convierte en una lectura temprana del estado de ánimo del consumidor de cara a los meses más ajetreados del año minorista.

segments.src: Spending is also highly discretionary and spread across many price points, from a bag of fun-size candy to an elaborate yard display.
segments.tr: El gasto también es altamente discrecional y se distribuye en muchos niveles de precios, desde una bolsa de dulces de tamaño pequeño hasta una elaborada decoración de jardín.

segments.src: Trade groups such as the National Retail Federation publish an annual forecast based on consumer surveys, and in recent years those projections have repeatedly pointed to historically high totals.
segments.tr: Grupos comerciales como la Federación Nacional de Minoristas publican un pronóstico anual basado en encuestas a los consumidores, y en los últimos años esas proyecciones han señalado repetidamente totales históricamente altos.

segments.src: A headline number alone, however, can mislead.
segments.tr: Una cifra principal por sí sola, sin embargo, puede inducir a error.

segments.src: Rising prices mean that even a flat unit volume can show up as higher dollar spending.
segments.tr: El aumento de los precios significa que incluso un volumen unitario plano puede aparecer como un mayor gasto en dólares.

segments.src: The more informative signals are in the details: what people buy, how much of it, and where they buy it.
segments.tr: Las señales más informativas están en los detalles: qué compra la gente, cuánto compra y dónde lo compra.

segments.src: ## Candy: The Staple That Absorbs Price Pressure
segments.tr: ## Dulces: el producto básico que absorbe la presión de los precios

segments.src: Candy is the core of the holiday and the category most households treat as non-negotiable.
segments.tr: Los dulces son el núcleo de la festividad y la categoría que la mayoría de los hogares trata como no negociable.

segments.src: Parents and neighbors who hand out treats rarely skip the purchase altogether.
segments.tr: Los padres y vecinos que reparten dulces rara vez omiten la compra por completo.

segments.src: Instead, behavior tends to change at the margins:
segments.tr: En cambio, el comportamiento tiende a cambiar en los márgenes:

segments.src: - **Smaller bags or fewer varieties.** Shoppers who once bought several brands may settle on one or two.
segments.tr: - **Bolsas más pequeñas o menos variedades.** Los compradores que antes compraban varias marcas pueden conformarse con una o dos.

segments.src: - **Store brands and bulk packs.** Value-oriented purchases tend to gain share when grocery bills rise.
segments.tr: - **Marcas de tienda y paquetes a granel.** Las compras orientadas al valor tienden a ganar participación cuando aumentan las facturas de comestibles.

segments.src: - **Earlier or later buying.** Some households shop early to catch promotions; others wait for clearance pricing in the final days.
segments.tr: - **Compra anticipada o tardía.** Algunos hogares compran temprano para aprovechar las promociones; otros esperan los precios de liquidación en los últimos días.

segments.src: Cocoa and sugar costs, along with packaging and transportation expenses, have been cited by manufacturers as pressures on chocolate pricing in recent seasons.
segments.tr: Los costos del cacao y el azúcar, junto con los gastos de embalaje y transporte, han sido citados por los fabricantes como presiones sobre los precios del chocolate en las últimas temporadas.

segments.src: For consumers, the practical result is that the same budget buys somewhat less, which can shape how many trick-or-treaters a household feels it can comfortably serve.
segments.tr: Para los consumidores, el resultado práctico es que el mismo presupuesto compra algo menos, lo que puede determinar a cuántos niños que piden dulces siente un hogar que puede atender cómodamente.

segments.src: ## Costumes: Where Choices Get More Selective
segments.tr: ## Disfraces: donde las elecciones se vuelven más selectivas

segments.src: Costumes are the most discretionary part of the holiday, and they offer the clearest window into how shoppers weigh a small luxury against everyday costs.
segments.tr: Los disfraces son la parte más discrecional de la festividad y ofrecen la ventana más clara sobre cómo los compradores sopesan un pequeño lujo frente a los costos cotidianos.

segments.src: Several patterns tend to appear when budgets are under strain:
segments.tr: Varios patrones tienden a aparecer cuando los presupuestos están bajo presión:

segments.src: - **Reuse and swapping.** Families pass costumes among siblings, friends and neighbors.
segments.tr: - **Reutilización e intercambio.** Las familias pasan los disfraces entre hermanos, amigos y vecinos.

segments.src: - **Do-it-yourself looks.** Assembling an outfit from items already in the closet is a popular way to cut costs.
segments.tr: - **Looks hechos por uno mismo.** Armar un atuendo con artículos que ya están en el armario es una forma popular de reducir costos.

segments.src: - **Secondhand and resale options.** Thrift stores and online marketplaces see more traffic as the holiday approaches.
segments.tr: - **Opciones de segunda mano y reventa.** Las tiendas de segunda mano y los mercados en línea ven más tráfico a medida que se acerca la festividad.

segments.src: - **Pets and children first.** Many households protect spending on kids' costumes while cutting back on their own.
segments.tr: - **Primero las mascotas y los niños.** Muchos hogares protegen el gasto en disfraces para niños mientras recortan los suyos.

segments.src: Because costume trends often follow popular films, shows and games, retailers also face inventory risk.
segments.tr: Debido a que las tendencias de disfraces a menudo siguen a películas, programas y juegos populares, los minoristas también enfrentan riesgos de inventario.

segments.src: A character that surges in popularity can sell out quickly, while a miss leaves shelves full of discounted stock.
segments.tr: Un personaje que aumenta en popularidad puede agotarse rápidamente, mientras que un fracaso deja los estantes llenos de existencias con descuento.

segments.src: ## Decorations: A Measure of Confidence in the Home
segments.tr: ## Decoraciones: una medida de confianza en el hogar

segments.src: Decorations are the category that most clearly separates comfortable budgets from cautious ones.
segments.tr: Las decoraciones son la categoría que separa más claramente los presupuestos cómodos de los cautelosos.

segments.src: Large inflatables, lighting and themed props can be expensive, and they are durable enough that many people choose to reuse last year's collection.
segments.tr: Los inflables grandes, la iluminación y los accesorios temáticos pueden ser costosos, y son lo suficientemente duraderos como para que muchas personas opten por reutilizar la colección del año pasado.

segments.src: When shoppers feel optimistic, they are more likely to add new pieces.
segments.tr: Cuando los compradores se sienten optimistas, es más probable que agreguen piezas nuevas.

segments.src: When they are uncertain, they tend to refresh a few items instead of buying a full display.
segments.tr: Cuando están inseguros, tienden a renovar algunos artículos en lugar de comprar una exhibición completa.

segments.src: The growth of Halloween as a season rather than a single night has also shaped this category.
segments.tr: El crecimiento de Halloween como temporada en lugar de una sola noche también ha dado forma a esta categoría.

segments.src: Retailers now stock seasonal merchandise earlier, and some consumers begin decorating weeks in advance.
segments.tr: Los minoristas ahora almacenan mercancía de temporada antes, y algunos consumidores comienzan a decorar con semanas de antelación.

segments.src: That longer window gives households more time to compare prices, wait for sales and spread purchases across several paychecks.
segments.tr: Esa ventana más larga les da a los hogares más tiempo para comparar precios, esperar ofertas y distribuir las compras en varios cheques de pago.

segments.src: ## How Inflation Shapes the Basket
segments.tr: ## Cómo la inflación da forma a la cesta

segments.src: Inflation does not simply raise the total; it changes the composition of what people buy.
segments.tr: La inflación no simplemente aumenta el total; cambia la composición de lo que compra la gente.

segments.src: A few dynamics are worth keeping in mind when reading any seasonal forecast:
segments.tr: Vale la pena tener en cuenta algunas dinámicas al leer cualquier pronóstico estacional:

segments.src: 1. **Nominal versus real spending.** A record dollar figure may reflect higher prices rather than more goods.
segments.tr: 1. **Gasto nominal frente al real.** Una cifra récord en dólares puede reflejar precios más altos en lugar de más bienes.

segments.src: 2. **Trading down.** Shoppers often move toward lower-priced brands or retailers, which can shift where the money goes even if the total holds steady.
segments.tr: 2. **Cambiar a opciones más baratas.** Los compradores a menudo se mueven hacia marcas o minoristas de menor precio, lo que puede cambiar a dónde va el dinero incluso si el total se mantiene estable.

segments.src: 3. **Uneven effects by income.** Higher-income households may maintain or increase spending, while lower-income households make visible cuts. Averages can hide that split.
segments.tr: 3. **Efectos desiguales por ingresos.** Los hogares con mayores ingresos pueden mantener o aumentar el gasto, mientras que los hogares con menores ingresos realizan recortes visibles. Los promedios pueden ocultar esa división.

segments.src: 4. **Credit and timing.** Some purchases are shifted to cards or to buy-now-pay-later options, which affects how comfortable spending actually is.
segments.tr: 4. **Crédito y tiempo.** Algunas compras se trasladan a tarjetas o a opciones de comprar ahora y pagar después, lo que afecta qué tan cómodo es realmente el gasto.

segments.src: ## What to Watch for the Rest of the Season
segments.tr: ## Qué observar durante el resto de la temporada

segments.src: Halloween is only one data point, but it is an early one.
segments.tr: Halloween es solo un punto de datos, pero es uno temprano.

segments.src: Analysts will be looking at how final sales compare with the forecasts, whether promotional activity picks up in the last week, and how much merchandise is left over for post-holiday clearance.
segments.tr: Los analistas observarán cómo se comparan las ventas finales con los pronósticos, si la actividad promocional aumenta en la última semana y cuánta mercancía queda para la liquidación posterior a la festividad.

segments.src: Heavy discounting after October 31 often suggests retailers misjudged demand, while thin clearance racks may indicate stronger-than-expected buying.
segments.tr: Los grandes descuentos después del 31 de octubre a menudo sugieren que los minoristas juzgaron mal la demanda, mientras que los estantes de liquidación vacíos pueden indicar una compra más fuerte de lo esperado.

segments.src: For households, the lesson is practical rather than predictive.
segments.tr: Para los hogares, la lección es práctica más que predictiva.

segments.src: Setting a firm budget in advance, comparing unit prices on candy, borrowing or reusing costumes and mixing new decorations with old ones can keep the holiday enjoyable without straining finances.
segments.tr: Establecer un presupuesto firme por adelantado, comparar los precios unitarios de los dulces, pedir prestados o reutilizar disfraces y mezclar decoraciones nuevas con antiguas puede mantener la festividad agradable sin afectar las finanzas.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## La conclusión

segments.src: Halloween spending is not a perfect gauge of the economy, and forecasts are estimates that can be revised.
segments.tr: El gasto en Halloween no es un indicador perfecto de la economía, y los pronósticos son estimaciones que pueden revisarse.

ar.title: الهالوين بالأرقام: ما تكشفه الحلوى والأزياء والديكورات عن ثقة المستهلك

segments.src: Every October, a familiar question returns to the retail world: how much are Americans willing to spend on a holiday that is, by almost any definition, optional?
segments.tr: في كل شهر أكتوبر، يعود سؤال مألوف إلى عالم التجزئة: ما هو المبلغ الذي يرغب الأمريكيون في إنفاقه على عطلة تعتبر، بأي تعريف تقريبًا، اختيارية؟

segments.src: Halloween has no gift obligations, no family travel and no formal dinner.
segments.tr: لا يتضمن الهالوين أي التزامات بتقديم هدايا، ولا سفر عائلي، ولا عشاء رسمي.

segments.src: That is precisely why economists and retail analysts watch it.
segments.tr: وهذا هو السبب الدقيق الذي يجعل الاقتصاديين ومحللي التجزئة يراقبونه.

segments.src: When households feel secure, the candy aisle and the costume rack tend to show it.
segments.tr: عندما تشعر الأسر بالأمان، تميل ممرات الحلوى ورفوف الأزياء إلى إظهار ذلك.

segments.src: When budgets tighten, those same categories are often among the first places shoppers trim.
segments.tr: وعندما تضيق الميزانيات، غالبًا ما تكون تلك الفئات نفسها من بين أول الأماكن التي يقلص فيها المتسوقون إنفاقهم.

segments.src: ## Why Halloween Is a Useful Barometer
segments.tr: ## لماذا يعتبر الهالوين مقياسًا مفيدًا

segments.src: Halloween sits in a distinctive spot on the calendar.
segments.tr: يحتل الهالوين مكانة مميزة في التقويم.

segments.src: It arrives before the peak of holiday shopping, which makes it an early read on the mood of the consumer heading into the busiest months of the retail year.
segments.tr: إنه يأتي قبل ذروة موسم التسوق في العطلات، مما يجعله مؤشرًا مبكرًا على مزاج المستهلك قبل الدخول في أكثر أشهر العام ازدحامًا في قطاع التجزئة.

segments.src: Spending is also highly discretionary and spread across many price points, from a bag of fun-size candy to an elaborate yard display.
segments.tr: كما أن الإنفاق اختياري للغاية وموزع عبر العديد من نقاط الأسعار، بدءًا من كيس من الحلوى الصغيرة إلى ديكورات الفناء المتقنة.

segments.src: Trade groups such as the National Retail Federation publish an annual forecast based on consumer surveys, and in recent years those projections have repeatedly pointed to historically high totals.
segments.tr: تنشر المجموعات التجارية مثل الاتحاد الوطني للبيع بالتجزئة توقعات سنوية بناءً على استطلاعات رأي المستهلكين، وفي السنوات الأخيرة أشارت تلك التوقعات مرارًا وتكرارًا إلى إجماليات مرتفعة تاريخيًا.

segments.src: A headline number alone, however, can mislead.
segments.tr: ومع ذلك، يمكن لرقم العنوان وحده أن يضلل.

segments.src: Rising prices mean that even a flat unit volume can show up as higher dollar spending.
segments.tr: يعني ارتفاع الأسعار أن حجم الوحدات الثابت قد يظهر كإنفاق دولاري أعلى.

segments.src: The more informative signals are in the details: what people buy, how much of it, and where they buy it.
segments.tr: الإشارات الأكثر دلالة تكمن في التفاصيل: ما الذي يشتريه الناس، وكميته، وأين يشترونه.

segments.src: ## Candy: The Staple That Absorbs Price Pressure
segments.tr: ## الحلوى: السلعة الأساسية التي تمتص ضغوط الأسعار

segments.src: Candy is the core of the holiday and the category most households treat as non-negotiable.
segments.tr: الحلوى هي جوهر العطلة والفئة التي تتعامل معها معظم الأسر كأمر غير قابل للتفاوض.

segments.src: Parents and neighbors who hand out treats rarely skip the purchase altogether.
segments.tr: نادرًا ما يتخلى الآباء والجيران الذين يوزعون الحلوى عن الشراء تمامًا.

segments.src: Instead, behavior tends to change at the margins:
segments.tr: بدلاً من ذلك، يميل السلوك إلى التغير في الهوامش:

segments.src: - **Smaller bags or fewer varieties.** Shoppers who once bought several brands may settle on one or two.
segments.tr: - **أكياس أصغر أو أصناف أقل.** قد يكتفي المتسوقون الذين كانوا يشترون عدة علامات تجارية بواحدة أو اثنتين.

segments.src: - **Store brands and bulk packs.** Value-oriented purchases tend to gain share when grocery bills rise.
segments.tr: - **العلامات التجارية الخاصة بالمتاجر والعبوات الكبيرة.** تميل المشتريات الموجهة نحو القيمة إلى اكتساب حصة أكبر عندما ترتفع فواتير البقالة.

segments.src: - **Earlier or later buying.** Some households shop early to catch promotions; others wait for clearance pricing in the final days.
segments.tr: - **الشراء المبكر أو المتأخر.** تتسوق بعض الأسر مبكرًا لاغتنام العروض الترويجية؛ بينما ينتظر آخرون أسعار التصفية في الأيام الأخيرة.

segments.src: Cocoa and sugar costs, along with packaging and transportation expenses, have been cited by manufacturers as pressures on chocolate pricing in recent seasons.
segments.tr: أشار المصنعون إلى تكاليف الكاكاو والسكر، إلى جانب نفقات التعبئة والتغليف والنقل، كضغوط على أسعار الشوكولاتة في المواسم الأخيرة.

segments.src: For consumers, the practical result is that the same budget buys somewhat less, which can shape how many trick-or-treaters a household feels it can comfortably serve.
segments.tr: بالنسبة للمستهلكين، النتيجة العملية هي أن الميزانية نفسها تشتري أقل إلى حد ما، وهو ما يمكن أن يشكل عدد الأطفال الذين يطرقون الأبواب لطلب الحلوى الذين تشعر الأسرة أنها تستطيع خدمتهم براحة.

segments.src: ## Costumes: Where Choices Get More Selective
segments.tr: ## الأزياء: حيث تصبح الخيارات أكثر انتقائية

segments.src: Costumes are the most discretionary part of the holiday, and they offer the clearest window into how shoppers weigh a small luxury against everyday costs.
segments.tr: الأزياء هي الجزء الأكثر اختيارية في العطلة، وهي توفر نافذة أوضح على كيفية موازنة المتسوقين بين رفاهية صغيرة والتكاليف اليومية.

segments.src: Several patterns tend to appear when budgets are under strain:
segments.tr: تميل عدة أنماط إلى الظهور عندما تكون الميزانيات تحت الضغط:

segments.src: - **Reuse and swapping.** Families pass costumes among siblings, friends and neighbors.
segments.tr: - **إعادة الاستخدام والتبادل.** يتناقل أفراد الأسرة الأزياء بين الأشقاء والأصدقاء والجيران.

segments.src: - **Do-it-yourself looks.** Assembling an outfit from items already in the closet is a popular way to cut costs.
segments.tr: - **المظهر المصنوع يدويًا.** يعد تجميع زي من عناصر موجودة بالفعل في الخزانة طريقة شائعة لخفض التكاليف.

segments.src: - **Secondhand and resale options.** Thrift stores and online marketplaces see more traffic as the holiday approaches.
segments.tr: - **خيارات المستعمل وإعادة البيع.** تشهد متاجر التوفير والأسواق عبر الإنترنت حركة مرور أكبر مع اقتراب العطلة.

segments.src: - **Pets and children first.** Many households protect spending on kids' costumes while cutting back on their own.
segments.tr: - **الحيوانات الأليفة والأطفال أولاً.** تحمي العديد من الأسر الإنفاق على أزياء الأطفال بينما تقلص الإنفاق على أزيائها الخاصة.

segments.src: Because costume trends often follow popular films, shows and games, retailers also face inventory risk.
segments.tr: نظرًا لأن اتجاهات الأزياء غالبًا ما تتبع الأفلام والعروض والألعاب الشهيرة، يواجه تجار التجزئة أيضًا مخاطر المخزون.

segments.src: A character that surges in popularity can sell out quickly, while a miss leaves shelves full of discounted stock.
segments.tr: يمكن لشخصية تزداد شعبيتها أن تنفد بسرعة، بينما يترك الفشل في التوقعات الرفوف مليئة بالمخزون المخفض.

segments.src: ## Decorations: A Measure of Confidence in the Home
segments.tr: ## الديكورات: مقياس للثقة في المنزل

segments.src: Decorations are the category that most clearly separates comfortable budgets from cautious ones.
segments.tr: الديكورات هي الفئة التي تفصل بوضوح أكبر بين الميزانيات المريحة والميزانيات الحذرة.

segments.src: Large inflatables, lighting and themed props can be expensive, and they are durable enough that many people choose to reuse last year's collection.
segments.tr: يمكن أن تكون الديكورات القابلة للنفخ الكبيرة، والإضاءة، والدعائم ذات الطابع الخاص باهظة الثمن، وهي متينة بما يكفي لدرجة أن الكثير من الناس يختارون إعادة استخدام مجموعة العام الماضي.

segments.src: When shoppers feel optimistic, they are more likely to add new pieces.
segments.tr: عندما يشعر المتسوقون بالتفاؤل، فمن المرجح أن يضيفوا قطعًا جديدة.

segments.src: When they are uncertain, they tend to refresh a few items instead of buying a full display.
segments.tr: وعندما يكونون غير متأكدين، فإنهم يميلون إلى تجديد بضع قطع بدلاً من شراء عرض كامل.

segments.src: The growth of Halloween as a season rather than a single night has also shaped this category.
segments.tr: لقد شكل نمو الهالوين كموسم بدلاً من ليلة واحدة هذه الفئة أيضًا.

segments.src: Retailers now stock seasonal merchandise earlier, and some consumers begin decorating weeks in advance.
segments.tr: يقوم تجار التجزئة الآن بتخزين البضائع الموسمية في وقت مبكر، ويبدأ بعض المستهلكين في التزيين قبل أسابيع.

segments.src: That longer window gives households more time to compare prices, wait for sales and spread purchases across several paychecks.
segments.tr: تمنح هذه النافذة الأطول الأسر مزيدًا من الوقت لمقارنة الأسعار، وانتظار التخفيضات، وتوزيع المشتريات على عدة رواتب.

segments.src: ## How Inflation Shapes the Basket
segments.tr: ## كيف يشكل التضخم سلة المشتريات

segments.src: Inflation does not simply raise the total; it changes the composition of what people buy.
segments.tr: التضخم لا يرفع الإجمالي فحسب؛ بل يغير تكوين ما يشتريه الناس.

segments.src: A few dynamics are worth keeping in mind when reading any seasonal forecast:
segments.tr: هناك بعض الديناميكيات التي تستحق أن نضعها في الاعتبار عند قراءة أي توقعات موسمية:

segments.src: 1. **Nominal versus real spending.** A record dollar figure may reflect higher prices rather than more goods.
segments.tr: 1. **الإنفاق الاسمي مقابل الحقيقي.** قد يعكس رقم الدولار القياسي ارتفاع الأسعار بدلاً من زيادة السلع.

segments.src: 2. **Trading down.** Shoppers often move toward lower-priced brands or retailers, which can shift where the money goes even if the total holds steady.
segments.tr: 2. **التداول لأسفل.** غالبًا ما ينتقل المتسوقون نحو العلامات التجارية أو تجار التجزئة الأقل سعرًا، مما قد يغير وجهة الأموال حتى لو ظل الإجمالي ثابتًا.

segments.src: 3. **Uneven effects by income.** Higher-income households may maintain or increase spending, while lower-income households make visible cuts. Averages can hide that split.
segments.tr: 3. **تأثيرات غير متكافئة حسب الدخل.** قد تحافظ الأسر ذات الدخل المرتفع على الإنفاق أو تزيده، بينما تقوم الأسر ذات الدخل المنخفض بتخفيضات واضحة. يمكن للمتوسطات أن تخفي هذا الانقسام.

segments.src: 4. **Credit and timing.** Some purchases are shifted to cards or to buy-now-pay-later options, which affects how comfortable spending actually is.
segments.tr: 4. **الائتمان والتوقيت.** يتم تحويل بعض المشتريات إلى البطاقات أو خيارات الشراء الآن والدفع لاحقًا، مما يؤثر على مدى راحة الإنفاق فعليًا.

segments.src: ## What to Watch for the Rest of the Season
segments.tr: ## ما يجب مراقبته لبقية الموسم

segments.src: Halloween is only one data point, but it is an early one.
segments.tr: الهالوين هو مجرد نقطة بيانات واحدة، لكنها نقطة مبكرة.

segments.src: Analysts will be looking at how final sales compare with the forecasts, whether promotional activity picks up in the last week, and how much merchandise is left over for post-holiday clearance.
segments.tr: سينظر المحللون في كيفية مقارنة المبيعات النهائية بالتوقعات، وما إذا كان النشاط الترويجي يرتفع في الأسبوع الأخير، وكمية البضائع المتبقية للتصفية بعد العطلة.

segments.src: Heavy discounting after October 31 often suggests retailers misjudged demand, while thin clearance racks may indicate stronger-than-expected buying.
segments.tr: غالبًا ما تشير التخفيضات الكبيرة بعد 31 أكتوبر إلى أن تجار التجزئة أخطأوا في تقدير الطلب، بينما قد تشير رفوف التصفية الفارغة إلى عمليات شراء أقوى من المتوقع.

segments.src: For households, the lesson is practical rather than predictive.
segments.tr: بالنسبة للأسر، الدرس عملي وليس تنبؤيًا.

segments.src: Setting a firm budget in advance, comparing unit prices on candy, borrowing or reusing costumes and mixing new decorations with old ones can keep the holiday enjoyable without straining finances.
segments.tr: إن وضع ميزانية ثابتة مسبقًا، ومقارنة أسعار الوحدات للحلوى، واستعارة أو إعادة استخدام الأزياء، وخلط الديكورات الجديدة بالقديمة يمكن أن يجعل العطلة ممتعة دون إجهاد الموارد المالية.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: Halloween spending is not a perfect gauge of the economy, and forecasts are estimates that can be revised.
segments.tr: إن إنفاق الهالوين ليس مقياسًا مثاليًا للاقتصاد، والتوقعات هي تقديرات يمكن مراجعتها.

segments.src: Still, the holiday offers a useful, human-scale look at how people are balancing small pleasures against rising costs.
segments.tr: ومع ذلك، تقدم العطلة نظرة مفيدة على نطاق إنساني حول كيفية موازنة الناس بين الملذات الصغيرة والتكاليف المتزايدة.

segments.src: This year, the story is less about whether Americans will celebrate and more about how they choose to do it: carefully, selectively and, in many cases, creatively.
segments.tr: هذا العام، القصة تتعلق أقل بما إذا كان الأمريكيون سيحتفلون وأكثر بكيفية اختيارهم للقيام بذلك: بحذر، وانتقائية، وفي كثير من الحالات، بإبداع.

segments.tr: *هذه المقالة لأغراض إعلامية عامة فقط ولا تشكل نصيحة مالية أو استثمارية.

segments.src: Figures and forecasts referenced are general in nature; readers should consult current reports from official or industry sources for the latest data.*
segments.tr: الأرقام والتوقعات المشار إليها ذات طبيعة عامة؛ يجب على القراء الرجوع إلى التقارير الحالية من المصادر الرسمية أو الصناعية للحصول على أحدث البيانات.*

fr.title: Halloween en chiffres : ce que les bonbons, les costumes et les décorations révèlent sur la confiance des consommateurs

segments.src: Every October, a familiar question returns to the retail world: how much are Americans willing to spend on a holiday that is, by almost any definition, optional?
segments.tr: Chaque mois d'octobre, une question familière revient dans le monde du commerce de détail : combien les Américains sont-ils prêts à dépenser pour une fête qui est, selon presque toutes les définitions, facultative ?

segments.src: Halloween has no gift obligations, no family travel and no formal dinner.
segments.tr: Halloween n'implique aucune obligation de cadeaux, aucun voyage en famille ni aucun dîner formel.

segments.src: That is precisely why economists and retail analysts watch it.
segments.tr: C'est précisément pour cette raison que les économistes et les analystes du commerce de détail l'observent.

segments.src: When households feel secure, the candy aisle and the costume rack tend to show it.
segments.tr: Lorsque les ménages se sentent en sécurité, le rayon des bonbons et celui des costumes ont tendance à le montrer.

segments.src: When budgets tighten, those same categories are often among the first places shoppers trim.
segments.tr: Lorsque les budgets se resserrent, ces mêmes catégories sont souvent parmi les premières sur lesquelles les acheteurs réduisent leurs dépenses.

segments.src: ## Why Halloween Is a Useful Barometer
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi Halloween est un baromètre utile

segments.src: Halloween sits in a distinctive spot on the calendar.
segments.tr: Halloween occupe une place particulière dans le calendrier.

segments.src: It arrives before the peak of holiday shopping, which makes it an early read on the mood of the consumer heading into the busiest months of the retail year.
segments.tr: Elle arrive avant le pic des achats de fin d'année, ce qui en fait un indicateur précoce de l'humeur des consommateurs à l'approche des mois les plus chargés de l'année commerciale.

segments.src: Spending is also highly discretionary and spread across many price points, from a bag of fun-size candy to an elaborate yard display.
segments.tr: Les dépenses sont également très discrétionnaires et réparties sur de nombreux niveaux de prix, allant d'un sachet de bonbons de petite taille à une décoration de jardin élaborée.

segments.src: Trade groups such as the National Retail Federation publish an annual forecast based on consumer surveys, and in recent years those projections have repeatedly pointed to historically high totals.
segments.tr: Des groupes professionnels tels que la National Retail Federation publient des prévisions annuelles basées sur des enquêtes auprès des consommateurs, et ces dernières années, ces projections ont à plusieurs reprises indiqué des totaux historiquement élevés.

segments.src: A headline number alone, however, can mislead.
segments.tr: Un chiffre global seul, cependant, peut être trompeur.

segments.src: Rising prices mean that even a flat unit volume can show up as higher dollar spending.
segments.tr: La hausse des prix signifie que même un volume unitaire stable peut se traduire par des dépenses en dollars plus élevées.

segments.src: The more informative signals are in the details: what people buy, how much of it, and where they buy it.
segments.tr: Les signaux les plus informatifs se trouvent dans les détails : ce que les gens achètent, en quelle quantité et où ils l'achètent.

segments.src: ## Candy: The Staple That Absorbs Price Pressure
segments.tr: ## Les bonbons : l'incontournable qui absorbe la pression sur les prix

segments.src: Candy is the core of the holiday and the category most households treat as non-negotiable.
segments.tr: Les bonbons sont au cœur de la fête et constituent la catégorie que la plupart des ménages considèrent comme non négociable.

segments.src: Parents and neighbors who hand out treats rarely skip the purchase altogether.
segments.tr: Les parents et les voisins qui distribuent des friandises sautent rarement l'achat.

segments.src: Instead, behavior tends to change at the margins:
segments.tr: Au lieu de cela, le comportement a tendance à changer à la marge :

segments.src: - **Smaller bags or fewer varieties.** Shoppers who once bought several brands may settle on one or two.
segments.tr: - **Sachets plus petits ou moins de variétés.** Les acheteurs qui achetaient autrefois plusieurs marques peuvent se contenter d'une ou deux.

segments.src: - **Store brands and bulk packs.** Value-oriented purchases tend to gain share when grocery bills rise.
segments.tr: - **Marques de distributeur et formats familiaux.** Les achats axés sur la valeur ont tendance à gagner des parts de marché lorsque les factures d'épicerie augmentent.

segments.src: - **Earlier or later buying.** Some households shop early to catch promotions; others wait for clearance pricing in the final days.
segments.tr: - **Achats plus précoces ou plus tardifs.** Certains ménages achètent tôt pour profiter des promotions ; d'autres attendent les soldes des derniers jours.

segments.src: Cocoa and sugar costs, along with packaging and transportation expenses, have been cited by manufacturers as pressures on chocolate pricing in recent seasons.
segments.tr: Les coûts du cacao et du sucre, ainsi que les dépenses d'emballage et de transport, ont été cités par les fabricants comme des pressions sur le prix du chocolat au cours des dernières saisons.

segments.src: For consumers, the practical result is that the same budget buys somewhat less, which can shape how many trick-or-treaters a household feels it can comfortably serve.
segments.tr: Pour les consommateurs, le résultat pratique est que le même budget permet d'acheter un peu moins, ce qui peut influencer le nombre de petits monstres qu'un ménage estime pouvoir servir confortablement.

segments.src: ## Costumes: Where Choices Get More Selective
segments.tr: ## Costumes : là où les choix deviennent plus sélectifs

segments.src: Costumes are the most discretionary part of the holiday, and they offer the clearest window into how shoppers weigh a small luxury against everyday costs.
segments.tr: Les costumes sont la partie la plus discrétionnaire de la fête, et ils offrent la fenêtre la plus claire sur la façon dont les acheteurs pèsent un petit luxe par rapport aux coûts quotidiens.

segments.src: Several patterns tend to appear when budgets are under strain:
segments.tr: Plusieurs modèles ont tendance à apparaître lorsque les budgets sont sous tension :

segments.src: - **Reuse and swapping.** Families pass costumes among siblings, friends and neighbors.
segments.tr: - **Réutilisation et échange.** Les familles se transmettent les costumes entre frères et sœurs, amis et voisins.

segments.src: - **Do-it-yourself looks.** Assembling an outfit from items already in the closet is a popular way to cut costs.
segments.tr: - **Looks faits maison.** Assembler une tenue à partir d'articles déjà présents dans le placard est un moyen populaire de réduire les coûts.

segments.src: - **Secondhand and resale options.** Thrift stores and online marketplaces see more traffic as the holiday approaches.
segments.tr: - **Options de seconde main et de revente.** Les friperies et les places de marché en ligne voient plus de trafic à l'approche de la fête.

segments.src: - **Pets and children first.** Many households protect spending on kids' costumes while cutting back on their own.
segments.tr: - **Les animaux de compagnie et les enfants d'abord.** De nombreux ménages protègent les dépenses pour les costumes des enfants tout en réduisant les leurs.

segments.src: Because costume trends often follow popular films, shows and games, retailers also face inventory risk.
segments.tr: Comme les tendances en matière de costumes suivent souvent les films, émissions et jeux populaires, les détaillants sont également confrontés à un risque d'inventaire.

segments.src: ## Decorations: A Measure of Confidence in the Home

segments.src: The growth of Halloween as a season rather than a single night has also shaped this category.

segments.src: Retailers now stock seasonal merchandise earlier, and some consumers begin decorating weeks in advance.
segments.tr: Les détaillants stockent désormais les marchandises saisonnières plus tôt, et certains consommateurs commencent à décorer des semaines à l'avance.

segments.src: That longer window gives households more time to compare prices, wait for sales and spread purchases across several paychecks.
segments.tr: Cette fenêtre plus longue donne aux ménages plus de temps pour comparer les prix, attendre les soldes et répartir les achats sur plusieurs paies.

segments.src: ## How Inflation Shapes the Basket
segments.tr: ## Comment l'inflation façonne le panier

segments.src: Inflation does not simply raise the total; it changes the composition of what people buy.
segments.tr: L'inflation n'augmente pas simplement le total ; elle modifie la composition de ce que les gens achètent.

segments.src: A few dynamics are worth keeping in mind when reading any seasonal forecast:
segments.tr: Quelques dynamiques méritent d'être gardées à l'esprit lors de la lecture de toute prévision saisonnière :

segments.src: 1. **Nominal versus real spending.** A record dollar figure may reflect higher prices rather than more goods.
segments.tr: 1. **Dépenses nominales versus réelles.** Un chiffre record en dollars peut refléter des prix plus élevés plutôt qu'une augmentation des biens.

segments.src: 2. **Trading down.** Shoppers often move toward lower-priced brands or retailers, which can shift where the money goes even if the total holds steady.
segments.tr: 2. **Descente en gamme.** Les acheteurs se tournent souvent vers des marques ou des détaillants moins chers, ce qui peut déplacer l'endroit où l'argent va même si le total reste stable.

segments.src: 3. **Uneven effects by income.** Higher-income households may maintain or increase spending, while lower-income households make visible cuts. Averages can hide that split.
segments.tr: 3. **Effets inégaux selon le revenu.** Les ménages à revenus élevés peuvent maintenir ou augmenter leurs dépenses, tandis que les ménages à faibles revenus font des coupes visibles. Les moyennes peuvent masquer cette fracture.

segments.src: 4. **Credit and timing.** Some purchases are shifted to cards or to buy-now-pay-later options, which affects how comfortable spending actually is.
segments.tr: 4. **Crédit et timing.** Certains achats sont reportés sur des cartes ou des options d'achat immédiat et de paiement différé, ce qui affecte le confort réel des dépenses.

segments.src: ## What to Watch for the Rest of the Season
segments.tr: ## Ce qu'il faut surveiller pour le reste de la saison

segments.src: Halloween is only one data point, but it is an early one.
segments.tr: Halloween n'est qu'un point de données, mais c'est un point précoce.

segments.src: Analysts will be looking at how final sales compare with the forecasts, whether promotional activity picks up in the last week, and how much merchandise is left over for post-holiday clearance.
segments.tr: Les analystes examineront comment les ventes finales se comparent aux prévisions, si l'activité promotionnelle s'intensifie au cours de la dernière semaine, et quelle quantité de marchandises reste pour les soldes d'après-fête.

segments.src: Heavy discounting after October 31 often suggests retailers misjudged demand, while thin clearance racks may indicate stronger-than-expected buying.
segments.tr: Des remises importantes après le 31 octobre suggèrent souvent que les détaillants ont mal évalué la demande, tandis que des rayons de soldes dégarnis peuvent indiquer des achats plus forts que prévu.

segments.src: For households, the lesson is practical rather than predictive.
segments.tr: Pour les ménages, la leçon est pratique plutôt que prédictive.

segments.src: Setting a firm budget in advance, comparing unit prices on candy, borrowing or reusing costumes and mixing new decorations with old ones can keep the holiday enjoyable without straining finances.
segments.tr: Fixer un budget ferme à l'avance, comparer les prix unitaires des bonbons, emprunter ou réutiliser des costumes et mélanger de nouvelles décorations avec d'anciennes peut permettre de profiter de la fête sans mettre à mal ses finances.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## L'essentiel

segments.src: Halloween spending is not a perfect gauge of the economy, and forecasts are estimates that can be revised.
segments.tr: Les dépenses d'Halloween ne sont pas une mesure parfaite de l'économie, et les prévisions sont des estimations qui peuvent être révisées.

segments.src: Still, the holiday offers a useful, human-scale look at how people are balancing small pleasures against rising costs.
segments.tr: Pourtant, la fête offre un regard utile et à échelle humaine sur la façon dont les gens équilibrent les petits plaisirs face à la hausse des coûts.

segments.src: This year, the story is less about whether Americans will celebrate and more about how they choose to do it: carefully, selectively and, in many cases, creatively.

pt.title: Halloween pelos números: O que doces, fantasias e decorações revelam sobre a confiança do consumidor

segments.src: Every October, a familiar question returns to the retail world: how much are Americans willing to spend on a holiday that is, by almost any definition, optional?
segments.tr: Todo mês de outubro, uma pergunta familiar retorna ao mundo do varejo: quanto os americanos estão dispostos a gastar em um feriado que é, por quase qualquer definição, opcional?

segments.src: Halloween has no gift obligations, no family travel and no formal dinner.
segments.tr: O Halloween não tem obrigações de presentes, viagens familiares ou jantares formais.

segments.src: That is precisely why economists and retail analysts watch it.
segments.tr: É precisamente por isso que economistas e analistas de varejo o observam.

segments.src: When households feel secure, the candy aisle and the costume rack tend to show it.
segments.tr: Quando as famílias se sentem seguras, o corredor de doces e a arara de fantasias tendem a mostrar isso.

segments.src: When budgets tighten, those same categories are often among the first places shoppers trim.
segments.tr: Quando os orçamentos apertam, essas mesmas categorias costumam estar entre os primeiros lugares onde os compradores cortam gastos.

segments.src: ## Why Halloween Is a Useful Barometer
segments.tr: ## Por que o Halloween é um barômetro útil

segments.src: Halloween sits in a distinctive spot on the calendar.
segments.tr: O Halloween ocupa um lugar distinto no calendário.

segments.src: It arrives before the peak of holiday shopping, which makes it an early read on the mood of the consumer heading into the busiest months of the retail year.
segments.tr: Ele chega antes do pico das compras de fim de ano, o que o torna uma leitura inicial do humor do consumidor antes dos meses mais movimentados do ano no varejo.

segments.src: Spending is also highly discretionary and spread across many price points, from a bag of fun-size candy to an elaborate yard display.
segments.tr: Os gastos também são altamente discricionários e distribuídos por muitas faixas de preço, desde um pacote de doces em tamanho pequeno até uma decoração elaborada de jardim.

segments.src: Trade groups such as the National Retail Federation publish an annual forecast based on consumer surveys, and in recent years those projections have repeatedly pointed to historically high totals.
segments.tr: Grupos comerciais como a National Retail Federation publicam uma previsão anual baseada em pesquisas com consumidores e, nos últimos anos, essas projeções apontaram repetidamente para totais historicamente altos.

segments.src: A headline number alone, however, can mislead.
segments.tr: Um número principal, por si só, pode enganar.

segments.src: Rising prices mean that even a flat unit volume can show up as higher dollar spending.
segments.tr: O aumento dos preços significa que mesmo um volume de unidades estável pode aparecer como um gasto em dólares maior.

segments.src: The more informative signals are in the details: what people buy, how much of it, and where they buy it.
segments.tr: Os sinais mais informativos estão nos detalhes: o que as pessoas compram, quanto compram e onde compram.

segments.src: ## Candy: The Staple That Absorbs Price Pressure
segments.tr: ## Doces: O item básico que absorve a pressão dos preços

segments.src: Candy is the core of the holiday and the category most households treat as non-negotiable.
segments.tr: Os doces são o centro do feriado e a categoria que a maioria das famílias trata como inegociável.

segments.src: Parents and neighbors who hand out treats rarely skip the purchase altogether.
segments.tr: Pais e vizinhos que distribuem guloseimas raramente deixam de fazer a compra.

segments.src: Instead, behavior tends to change at the margins:
segments.tr: Em vez disso, o comportamento tende a mudar nas margens:

segments.src: - **Smaller bags or fewer varieties.** Shoppers who once bought several brands may settle on one or two.
segments.tr: - **Embalagens menores ou menos variedades.** Compradores que antes compravam várias marcas podem se contentar com uma ou duas.

segments.src: - **Store brands and bulk packs.** Value-oriented purchases tend to gain share when grocery bills rise.
segments.tr: - **Marcas próprias e pacotes grandes.** Compras orientadas pelo valor tendem a ganhar participação quando as contas de supermercado aumentam.

segments.src: - **Earlier or later buying.** Some households shop early to catch promotions; others wait for clearance pricing in the final days.
segments.tr: - **Compra antecipada ou tardia.** Algumas famílias compram cedo para aproveitar promoções; outras esperam pelos preços de liquidação nos últimos dias.

segments.src: Cocoa and sugar costs, along with packaging and transportation expenses, have been cited by manufacturers as pressures on chocolate pricing in recent seasons.
segments.tr: Os custos do cacau e do açúcar, juntamente com as despesas de embalagem e transporte, foram citados pelos fabricantes como pressões sobre os preços do chocolate nas últimas temporadas.

segments.src: For consumers, the practical result is that the same budget buys somewhat less, which can shape how many trick-or-treaters a household feels it can comfortably serve.
segments.tr: Para os consumidores, o resultado prático é que o mesmo orçamento compra um pouco menos, o que pode moldar quantas crianças pedindo doces ou travessuras uma família sente que pode atender confortavelmente.

segments.src: ## Costumes: Where Choices Get More Selective
segments.tr: ## Fantasias: Onde as escolhas se tornam mais seletivas

segments.src: Costumes are the most discretionary part of the holiday, and they offer the clearest window into how shoppers weigh a small luxury against everyday costs.
segments.tr: As fantasias são a parte mais discricionária do feriado e oferecem a janela mais clara para como os compradores equilibram um pequeno luxo com os custos do dia a dia.

segments.src: Several patterns tend to appear when budgets are under strain:
segments.tr: Vários padrões tendem a aparecer quando os orçamentos estão sob pressão:

segments.src: - **Reuse and swapping.** Families pass costumes among siblings, friends and neighbors.
segments.tr: - **Reutilização e troca.** Famílias passam fantasias entre irmãos, amigos e vizinhos.

segments.src: - **Do-it-yourself looks.** Assembling an outfit from items already in the closet is a popular way to cut costs.
segments.tr: - **Looks "faça você mesmo".** Montar uma roupa com itens que já estão no armário é uma maneira popular de reduzir custos.

segments.src: - **Secondhand and resale options.** Thrift stores and online marketplaces see more traffic as the holiday approaches.
segments.tr: - **Opções de segunda mão e revenda.** Brechós e mercados online veem mais tráfego à medida que o feriado se aproxima.

segments.src: - **Pets and children first.** Many households protect spending on kids' costumes while cutting back on their own.
segments.tr: - **Pets e crianças primeiro.** Muitas famílias protegem os gastos com fantasias infantis enquanto cortam os seus próprios.

segments.src: Because costume trends often follow popular films, shows and games, retailers also face inventory risk.
segments.tr: Como as tendências de fantasias geralmente seguem filmes, programas e jogos populares, os varejistas também enfrentam risco de estoque.

segments.src: A character that surges in popularity can sell out quickly, while a miss leaves shelves full of discounted stock.

segments.src: When shoppers feel optimistic, they are more likely to add new pieces.

segments.src: When they are uncertain, they tend to refresh a few items instead of buying a full display.
segments.tr: Quando estão incertos, tendem a renovar alguns itens em vez de comprar uma exibição completa.

segments.src: The growth of Halloween as a season rather than a single night has also shaped this category.
segments.tr: O crescimento do Halloween como uma temporada, em vez de uma única noite, também moldou essa categoria.
