segments.tr: ## Kostum: Tempat Pilihan Menjadi Lebih Selektif

segments.src: Costumes are the most discretionary part of the holiday, and they offer the clearest window into how shoppers weigh a small luxury against everyday costs.
segments.tr: Kostum adalah bagian liburan yang paling diskresioner, dan kostum menawarkan jendela paling jelas tentang bagaimana pembeli menimbang kemewahan kecil terhadap biaya sehari-hari.

segments.src: Several patterns tend to appear when budgets are under strain:
segments.tr: Beberapa pola cenderung muncul ketika anggaran berada di bawah tekanan:

segments.src: - **Reuse and swapping.** Families pass costumes among siblings, friends and neighbors.
segments.tr: - **Penggunaan ulang dan penukaran.** Keluarga saling meminjamkan kostum di antara saudara kandung, teman, dan tetangga.

segments.src: - **Do-it-yourself looks.** Assembling an outfit from items already in the closet is a popular way to cut costs.
segments.tr: - **Tampilan buatan sendiri.** Merakit pakaian dari barang-barang yang sudah ada di lemari adalah cara populer untuk memangkas biaya.

segments.src: - **Secondhand and resale options.** Thrift stores and online marketplaces see more traffic as the holiday approaches.
segments.tr: - **Pilihan barang bekas dan penjualan kembali.** Toko barang bekas dan pasar online melihat lebih banyak kunjungan saat liburan mendekat.

segments.src: - **Pets and children first.** Many households protect spending on kids' costumes while cutting back on their own.
segments.tr: - **Hewan peliharaan dan anak-anak didahulukan.** Banyak rumah tangga melindungi pengeluaran untuk kostum anak-anak sambil mengurangi pengeluaran untuk diri mereka sendiri.

segments.src: Because costume trends often follow popular films, shows and games, retailers also face inventory risk.
segments.tr: Karena tren kostum sering kali mengikuti film, pertunjukan, dan permainan populer, peritel juga menghadapi risiko inventaris.

segments.src: A character that surges in popularity can sell out quickly, while a miss leaves shelves full of discounted stock.
segments.tr: Karakter yang melonjak popularitasnya dapat terjual dengan cepat, sementara karakter yang gagal meninggalkan rak-rak penuh dengan stok diskon.

segments.src: ## Decorations: A Measure of Confidence in the Home
segments.tr: ## Dekorasi: Ukuran Kepercayaan di Dalam Rumah

segments.src: Decorations are the category that most clearly separates comfortable budgets from cautious ones.
segments.tr: Dekorasi adalah kategori yang paling jelas memisahkan anggaran yang nyaman dari anggaran yang berhati-hati.

segments.src: Large inflatables, lighting and themed props can be expensive, and they are durable enough that many people choose to reuse last year's collection.
segments.tr: Barang tiup besar, pencahayaan, dan properti bertema bisa mahal, dan barang-barang tersebut cukup tahan lama sehingga banyak orang memilih untuk menggunakan kembali koleksi tahun lalu.

segments.src: When shoppers feel optimistic, they are more likely to add new pieces.
segments.tr: Ketika pembeli merasa optimis, mereka lebih cenderung menambahkan barang baru.

segments.src: When they are uncertain, they tend to refresh a few items instead of buying a full display.
segments.tr: Ketika mereka merasa tidak pasti, mereka cenderung menyegarkan beberapa item daripada membeli pajangan penuh.

segments.src: The growth of Halloween as a season rather than a single night has also shaped this category.
segments.tr: Pertumbuhan Halloween sebagai musim daripada sekadar satu malam juga telah membentuk kategori ini.

segments.src: Retailers now stock seasonal merchandise earlier, and some consumers begin decorating weeks in advance.
segments.tr: Peritel sekarang menyediakan barang musiman lebih awal, dan beberapa konsumen mulai mendekorasi beberapa minggu sebelumnya.

segments.src: That longer window gives households more time to compare prices, wait for sales and spread purchases across several paychecks.
segments.tr: Jangka waktu yang lebih lama tersebut memberi rumah tangga lebih banyak waktu untuk membandingkan harga, menunggu obral, dan menyebarkan pembelian ke beberapa kali penggajian.

segments.src: ## How Inflation Shapes the Basket
segments.tr: ## Bagaimana Inflasi Membentuk Keranjang Belanja

segments.src: Inflation does not simply raise the total; it changes the composition of what people buy.
segments.tr: Inflasi tidak hanya menaikkan total; inflasi mengubah komposisi dari apa yang dibeli orang.

segments.src: A few dynamics are worth keeping in mind when reading any seasonal forecast:
segments.tr: Beberapa dinamika perlu diingat saat membaca perkiraan musiman apa pun:

segments.src: 1. **Nominal versus real spending.** A record dollar figure may reflect higher prices rather than more goods.
segments.tr: 1. **Pengeluaran nominal versus riil.** Angka dolar yang tinggi mungkin mencerminkan harga yang lebih tinggi daripada jumlah barang yang lebih banyak.

segments.src: 2. **Trading down.** Shoppers often move toward lower-priced brands or retailers, which can shift where the money goes even if the total holds steady.
segments.tr: 2. **Beralih ke yang lebih murah.** Pembeli sering kali beralih ke merek atau peritel dengan harga lebih rendah, yang dapat menggeser ke mana uang pergi bahkan jika totalnya tetap stabil.

segments.src: 3. **Uneven effects by income.** Higher-income households may maintain or increase spending, while lower-income households make visible cuts. Averages can hide that split.
segments.tr: 3. **Efek yang tidak merata berdasarkan pendapatan.** Rumah tangga berpendapatan tinggi dapat mempertahankan atau meningkatkan pengeluaran, sementara rumah tangga berpendapatan rendah melakukan pemotongan yang terlihat. Rata-rata dapat menyembunyikan perpecahan tersebut.

segments.src: 4. **Credit and timing.** Some purchases are shifted to cards or to buy-now-pay-later options, which affects how comfortable spending actually is.
segments.tr: 4. **Kredit dan waktu.** Beberapa pembelian dialihkan ke kartu atau opsi beli sekarang bayar nanti, yang memengaruhi seberapa nyaman pengeluaran tersebut sebenarnya.

segments.src: ## What to Watch for the Rest of the Season
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Harus Diperhatikan untuk Sisa Musim Ini

segments.src: Halloween is only one data point, but it is an early one.
segments.tr: Halloween hanya satu titik data, tetapi itu adalah titik data yang awal.

segments.src: Analysts will be looking at how final sales compare with the forecasts, whether promotional activity picks up in the last week, and how much merchandise is left over for post-holiday clearance.
segments.tr: Analis akan melihat bagaimana penjualan akhir dibandingkan dengan perkiraan, apakah aktivitas promosi meningkat pada minggu terakhir, dan berapa banyak barang yang tersisa untuk obral pasca-liburan.

segments.src: Heavy discounting after October 31 often suggests retailers misjudged demand, while thin clearance racks may indicate stronger-than-expected buying.
segments.tr: Diskon besar-besaran setelah 31 Oktober sering kali menunjukkan bahwa peritel salah menilai permintaan, sementara rak obral yang tipis mungkin menunjukkan pembelian yang lebih kuat dari perkiraan.

segments.src: For households, the lesson is practical rather than predictive.
segments.tr: Bagi rumah tangga, pelajarannya bersifat praktis daripada prediktif.

segments.src: Setting a firm budget in advance, comparing unit prices on candy, borrowing or reusing costumes and mixing new decorations with old ones can keep the holiday enjoyable without straining finances.
segments.tr: Menetapkan anggaran yang tegas terlebih dahulu, membandingkan harga satuan pada permen, meminjam atau menggunakan kembali kostum, dan memadukan dekorasi baru dengan yang lama dapat membuat liburan tetap menyenangkan tanpa membebani keuangan.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Kesimpulan

segments.src: Halloween spending is not a perfect gauge of the economy, and forecasts are estimates that can be revised.
segments.tr: Pengeluaran Halloween bukanlah ukuran ekonomi yang sempurna, dan perkiraan adalah estimasi yang dapat direvisi.

segments.src: Still, the holiday offers a useful, human-scale look at how people are balancing small pleasures against rising costs.
segments.tr: Namun, liburan ini menawarkan pandangan yang berguna dan berskala manusia tentang bagaimana orang menyeimbangkan kesenangan kecil terhadap biaya yang meningkat.

segments.src: This year, the story is less about whether Americans will celebrate and more about how they choose to do it: carefully, selectively and, in many cases, creatively.
segments.tr: Tahun ini, kisahnya lebih tentang bagaimana orang Amerika memilih untuk merayakannya alih-alih apakah mereka akan merayakannya: dengan hati-hati, selektif, dan, dalam banyak kasus, kreatif.

ja.title: 数字で見るハロウィーン：お菓子、コスチューム、装飾が明らかにする消費者心理

segments.src: Every October, a familiar question returns to the retail world: how much are Americans willing to spend on a holiday that is, by almost any definition, optional?
segments.tr: 毎年10月になると、小売業界にはおなじみの問いが戻ってきます。それは、ほぼどのような定義においても「任意」である祝日に、アメリカ人はどれだけのお金を費やすつもりがあるのか、という問いです。

segments.src: Halloween has no gift obligations, no family travel and no formal dinner.
segments.tr: ハロウィーンには、贈り物の義務も、家族旅行も、正式なディナーもありません。

segments.src: That is precisely why economists and retail analysts watch it.
segments.tr: それこそが、経済学者や小売アナリストがこのイベントを注視する理由です。

segments.src: When households feel secure, the candy aisle and the costume rack tend to show it.
segments.tr: 家計に余裕があると感じるとき、お菓子売り場やコスチューム売り場にはそれが如実に表れます。

segments.src: When budgets tighten, those same categories are often among the first places shoppers trim.
segments.tr: 予算が厳しくなると、買い物客が真っ先に削る項目の一つが、まさにこれらのカテゴリーなのです。

segments.src: ## Why Halloween Is a Useful Barometer
segments.tr: ## なぜハロウィーンが有用なバロメーターなのか

segments.src: Halloween sits in a distinctive spot on the calendar.
segments.tr: ハロウィーンは、カレンダー上で独特な位置を占めています。

segments.src: It arrives before the peak of holiday shopping, which makes it an early read on the mood of the consumer heading into the busiest months of the retail year.
segments.tr: ホリデーシーズンの買い物のピーク前に到来するため、小売業界にとって最も忙しい数ヶ月に向かう消費者の気分を早期に読み取ることができるのです。

segments.src: Spending is also highly discretionary and spread across many price points, from a bag of fun-size candy to an elaborate yard display.
segments.tr: また、支出は非常に裁量的であり、ファンサイズのお菓子一袋から手の込んだ庭のディスプレイまで、幅広い価格帯に分散しています。

segments.src: Trade groups such as the National Retail Federation publish an annual forecast based on consumer surveys, and in recent years those projections have repeatedly pointed to historically high totals.
segments.tr: 全米小売業協会（National Retail Federation）のような業界団体は、消費者調査に基づいた年次予測を発表しており、近年、これらの予測は繰り返し歴史的な高水準を指し示してきました。

segments.src: A headline number alone, however, can mislead.
segments.tr: しかし、見出しの数字だけでは誤解を招く可能性があります。

segments.src: Rising prices mean that even a flat unit volume can show up as higher dollar spending.
segments.tr: 物価上昇は、販売数量が変わらなくても、ドルベースの支出額が増加しているように見えることを意味します。

segments.src: The more informative signals are in the details: what people buy, how much of it, and where they buy it.
segments.tr: より有益なシグナルは、詳細の中に隠されています。人々が何を買うのか、どれだけ買うのか、そしてどこで買うのか、ということです。

segments.src: ## Candy: The Staple That Absorbs Price Pressure
segments.tr: ## お菓子：価格圧力を吸収する定番品

segments.src: Candy is the core of the holiday and the category most households treat as non-negotiable.
segments.tr: お菓子はこの祝日の中心であり、ほとんどの家庭が「妥協できないもの」として扱うカテゴリーです。

segments.src: Parents and neighbors who hand out treats rarely skip the purchase altogether.
segments.tr: お菓子を配る親や近隣住民が、購入自体を完全にやめることはめったにありません。

segments.src: Instead, behavior tends to change at the margins:
segments.tr: その代わり、行動は周辺部分で変化する傾向があります。

segments.src: - **Smaller bags or fewer varieties.** Shoppers who once bought several brands may settle on one or two.
segments.tr: - **より小さな袋や種類の削減。** かつて複数のブランドを購入していた買い物客が、1つか2つに絞るようになることがあります。

segments.src: - **Store brands and bulk packs.** Value-oriented purchases tend to gain share when grocery bills rise.
segments.tr: - **ストアブランドや大容量パック。** 食料品代が上昇すると、価値重視の購入がシェアを伸ばす傾向があります。

segments.src: - **Earlier or later buying.** Some households shop early to catch promotions; others wait for clearance pricing in the final days.
segments.tr: - **早期または遅い購入。** プロモーションを狙って早めに買い物をする家庭もあれば、最終日のクリアランス価格を待つ家庭もあります。

segments.src: Cocoa and sugar costs, along with packaging and transportation expenses, have been cited by manufacturers as pressures on chocolate pricing in recent seasons.
segments.tr: ココアや砂糖のコスト、そして包装や輸送費は、ここ数シーズン、チョコレートの価格に対する圧力としてメーカーから指摘されてきました。

segments.src: For consumers, the practical result is that the same budget buys somewhat less, which can shape how many trick-or-treaters a household feels it can comfortably serve.
segments.tr: 消費者にとっての実質的な結果は、同じ予算で買えるものが少し減るということであり、それが家庭にとって「何人のトリック・オア・トリーターを快適にもてなせるか」という感覚を形作る可能性があります。

segments.src: ## Costumes: Where Choices Get More Selective
segments.tr: ## コスチューム：選択がより慎重になる分野

segments.src: Costumes are the most discretionary part of the holiday, and they offer the clearest window into how shoppers weigh a small luxury against everyday costs.
segments.tr: コスチュームはこの祝日の中で最も裁量的な部分であり、買い物客が小さな贅沢と日々のコストをどのように天秤にかけているかを知るための最も明確な窓口となります。

segments.src: Several patterns tend to appear when budgets are under strain:
segments.tr: 予算が逼迫しているときには、いくつかのパターンが現れる傾向があります。

segments.src: - **Reuse and swapping.** Families pass costumes among siblings, friends and neighbors.
segments.tr: - **再利用と交換。** 家族は兄弟、友人、近隣住民の間でコスチュームを回します。

segments.src: - **Do-it-yourself looks.** Assembling an outfit from items already in the closet is a popular way to cut costs.
segments.tr: - **DIY（手作り）。** クローゼットにあるアイテムを使って衣装を組み立てることは、コストを削減する一般的な方法です。

segments.src: - **Secondhand and resale options.** Thrift stores and online marketplaces see more traffic as the holiday approaches.
segments.tr: - **中古品やリセールオプション。** ホリデーが近づくにつれ、リサイクルショップやオンラインマーケットプレイスの利用が増えます。

segments.src: - **Pets and children first.** Many households protect spending on kids' costumes while cutting back on their own.
segments.tr: - **ペットと子供が優先。** 多くの家庭では、自分たちの支出を切り詰める一方で、子供のコスチュームへの支出は維持します。

segments.src: Because costume trends often follow popular films, shows and games, retailers also face inventory risk.
segments.tr: コスチュームのトレンドは人気映画、番組、ゲームに従うことが多いため、小売業者は在庫リスクにも直面します。

segments.src: A character that surges in popularity can sell out quickly, while a miss leaves shelves full of discounted stock.
segments.tr: 人気が急上昇したキャラクターはすぐに売り切れる可能性がありますが、外れた場合は割引在庫が棚に残ることになります。

segments.src: ## Decorations: A Measure of Confidence in the Home
segments.tr: ## 装飾：家庭の自信を測る尺度

segments.tr: 装飾は、家計に余裕があるか慎重かを最も明確に分けるカテゴリーです。

segments.src: When shoppers feel optimistic, they are more likely to add new pieces.
segments.tr: 買い物客が楽観的であるときは、新しいアイテムを追加する可能性が高くなります。

segments.tr: 不確実なときは、ディスプレイをすべて買い替えるのではなく、いくつかのアイテムを新しくする傾向があります。

segments.src: The growth of Halloween as a season rather than a single night has also shaped this category.
segments.tr: ハロウィーンが単なる一夜ではなく「シーズン」として成長したことも、このカテゴリーを形作ってきました。

segments.src: Retailers now stock seasonal merchandise earlier, and some consumers begin decorating weeks in advance.
segments.tr: 小売業者は現在、季節商品をより早く入荷しており、一部の消費者は数週間前から飾り付けを始めます。

segments.src: That longer window gives households more time to compare prices, wait for sales and spread purchases across several paychecks.
segments.tr: その長い期間のおかげで、家庭は価格を比較し、セールを待ち、複数の給料日に分けて購入を分散させる余裕が生まれます。

segments.src: ## How Inflation Shapes the Basket
segments.tr: ## インフレはどのように買い物かごを形作るか

segments.tr: インフレは単に合計額を上げるだけではありません。人々が何を買うかという構成を変化させます。

segments.src: A few dynamics are worth keeping in mind when reading any seasonal forecast:
segments.tr: 季節予測を読む際には、いくつかの力学を念頭に置く価値があります。

segments.src: 1. **Nominal versus real spending.** A record dollar figure may reflect higher prices rather than more goods.
segments.tr: 1. **名目支出と実質支出。** 記録的なドル額は、商品の増加ではなく、価格の上昇を反映している可能性があります。

segments.src: 2. **Trading down.** Shoppers often move toward lower-priced brands or retailers, which can shift where the money goes even if the total holds steady.
segments.tr: 2. **ダウントレード（格下げ）。** 買い物客はしばしば低価格のブランドや小売店に移行するため、合計額が変わらなくても、お金がどこに流れるかが変わる可能性があります。

segments.src: 3. **Uneven effects by income.** Higher-income households may maintain or increase spending, while lower-income households make visible cuts. Averages can hide that split.
segments.tr: 3. **所得による不均一な影響。** 高所得世帯は支出を維持または増加させる可能性がありますが、低所得世帯は目に見える削減を行います。平均値はその分裂を隠してしまうことがあります。

segments.src: 4. **Credit and timing.** Some purchases are shifted to cards or to buy-now-pay-later options, which affects how comfortable spending actually is.
segments.tr: 4. **クレジットとタイミング。** 一部の購入はカードや「今すぐ購入、後で支払い（BNPL）」オプションにシフトされており、これが実際の支出の快適さに影響を与えます。

segments.src: ## What to Watch for the Rest of the Season
segments.tr: ## シーズンの残りに注目すべきこと

segments.tr: アナリストは、最終的な売上が予測とどう比較されるか、最後の週に販促活動が活発になるか、そしてホリデー後のクリアランス用にどれだけの在庫が残っているかを注視するでしょう。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.tr: ハロウィーンの支出は経済の完璧な尺度ではなく、予測は修正される可能性のある見積もりに過ぎません。

de.title: Halloween in Zahlen: Was Süßigkeiten, Kostüme und Dekorationen über das Verbrauchervertrauen verraten

segments.src: Every October, a familiar question returns to the retail world: how much are Americans willing to spend on a holiday that is, by almost any definition, optional?
segments.tr: Jeden Oktober kehrt eine vertraute Frage in den Einzelhandel zurück: Wie viel sind Amerikaner bereit, für einen Feiertag auszugeben, der nach nahezu jeder Definition optional ist?

segments.src: Halloween has no gift obligations, no family travel and no formal dinner.
segments.tr: Halloween hat keine Schenkverpflichtungen, keine Familienreisen und kein formelles Abendessen.

segments.src: That is precisely why economists and retail analysts watch it.
segments.tr: Genau deshalb beobachten Ökonomen und Einzelhandelsanalysten es.

segments.src: When households feel secure, the candy aisle and the costume rack tend to show it.
segments.tr: Wenn sich Haushalte sicher fühlen, zeigen das das Süßigkeitenregal und der Kostümständer meist deutlich.

segments.src: When budgets tighten, those same categories are often among the first places shoppers trim.
segments.tr: Wenn die Budgets knapper werden, gehören genau diese Kategorien oft zu den ersten Bereichen, bei denen Käufer sparen.

segments.src: ## Why Halloween Is a Useful Barometer
segments.tr: ## Warum Halloween ein nützliches Barometer ist

segments.src: Halloween sits in a distinctive spot on the calendar.
segments.tr: Halloween nimmt einen ganz besonderen Platz im Kalender ein.

segments.src: It arrives before the peak of holiday shopping, which makes it an early read on the mood of the consumer heading into the busiest months of the retail year.
segments.tr: Es kommt vor dem Höhepunkt des Feiertagshandelstrends, was es zu einem frühen Indikator für die Stimmung der Verbraucher zu Beginn der geschäftigsten Monate des Einzelhandelsjahres macht.

segments.src: Spending is also highly discretionary and spread across many price points, from a bag of fun-size candy to an elaborate yard display.
segments.tr: Die Ausgaben sind zudem hochgradig diskretionär und verteilen sich auf viele Preiskategorien, von einer Tüte Mini-Süßigkeiten bis hin zu einer aufwendigen Hofdekoration.

segments.src: Trade groups such as the National Retail Federation publish an annual forecast based on consumer surveys, and in recent years those projections have repeatedly pointed to historically high totals.
segments.tr: Wirtschaftsverbände wie die National Retail Federation veröffentlichen jährliche Prognosen auf Basis von Verbraucherumfragen, und in den letzten Jahren wiesen diese Prognosen wiederholt auf historische Rekordsummen hin.

segments.src: A headline number alone, however, can mislead.
segments.tr: Eine reine Schlagzeilenzahl kann jedoch in die Irre führen.

segments.src: Rising prices mean that even a flat unit volume can show up as higher dollar spending.
segments.tr: Steigende Preise bedeuten, dass selbst ein gleichbleibendes Absatzvolumen als höhere Dollarausgaben erscheinen kann.

segments.src: The more informative signals are in the details: what people buy, how much of it, and where they buy it.
segments.tr: Die aussagekräftigeren Signale stecken in den Details: was die Leute kaufen, in welchen Mengen und wo sie es kaufen.

segments.src: ## Candy: The Staple That Absorbs Price Pressure
segments.tr: ## Süßigkeiten: Das Grundnahrungsmittel, das den Preisdruck abfängt

segments.src: Candy is the core of the holiday and the category most households treat as non-negotiable.
segments.tr: Süßigkeiten bilden den Kern des Feiertags und sind die Kategorie, die die meisten Haushalte als unverhandelbar ansehen.

segments.src: Parents and neighbors who hand out treats rarely skip the purchase altogether.
segments.tr: Eltern und Nachbarn, die Süßigkeiten verteilen, lassen diesen Kauf selten ganz aus.

segments.src: Instead, behavior tends to change at the margins:
segments.tr: Stattdessen ändert sich das Verhalten meist an den Rändern:

segments.src: - **Smaller bags or fewer varieties.** Shoppers who once bought several brands may settle on one or two.
segments.tr: - **Kleinere Tüten oder weniger Sorten.** Käufer, die früher mehrere Marken kauften, beschränken sich nun auf ein oder zwei.

segments.src: - **Store brands and bulk packs.** Value-oriented purchases tend to gain share when grocery bills rise.
segments.tr: - **Eigenmarken und Großpackungen.** Preisorientierte Käufe gewinnen tendenziell an Marktanteilen, wenn die Lebensmittelrechnungen steigen.

segments.src: - **Earlier or later buying.** Some households shop early to catch promotions; others wait for clearance pricing in the final days.
segments.tr: - **Früheres oder späteres Kaufen.** Einige Haushalte kaufen früh ein, um von Aktionen zu profitieren; andere warten in den letzten Tagen auf Rabattpreise.

segments.src: Cocoa and sugar costs, along with packaging and transportation expenses, have been cited by manufacturers as pressures on chocolate pricing in recent seasons.
segments.tr: Kakao- und Zuckerpreise sowie Kosten für Verpackung und Transport wurden von Herstellern in den letzten Saisons als Belastungen für die Schokoladenpreise genannt.

segments.src: For consumers, the practical result is that the same budget buys somewhat less, which can shape how many trick-or-treaters a household feels it can comfortably serve.
segments.tr: Für die Verbraucher ist das praktische Resultat, dass dasselbe Budget etwas weniger kauft, was beeinflussen kann, wie vielen Kindern an der Haustür ein Haushalt bequem eine Freude machen kann.

segments.src: ## Costumes: Where Choices Get More Selective
segments.tr: ## Kostüme: Wo die Auswahl wählerischer wird

segments.src: Costumes are the most discretionary part of the holiday, and they offer the clearest window into how shoppers weigh a small luxury against everyday costs.
segments.tr: Kostüme sind der diskretionärste Teil des Feiertags und bieten den klarsten Einblick darin, wie Käufer einen kleinen Luxus gegen die alltäglichen Kosten abwägen.

segments.src: Several patterns tend to appear when budgets are under strain:
segments.tr: Mehrere Muster zeigen sich tendenziell, wenn die Budgets unter Druck stehen:

segments.src: - **Reuse and swapping.** Families pass costumes among siblings, friends and neighbors.
segments.tr: - **Wiederverwendung und Tausch.** Familien geben Kostüme unter Geschwistern, Freunden und Nachbarn weiter.

segments.src: - **Do-it-yourself looks.** Assembling an outfit from items already in the closet is a popular way to cut costs.
segments.tr: - **Selbstgemachte Looks.** Ein Outfit aus bereits im Kleiderschrank vorhandenen Teilen zusammenzustellen ist eine beliebte Methode, um Kosten zu senken.

segments.src: - **Secondhand and resale options.** Thrift stores and online marketplaces see more traffic as the holiday approaches.
segments.tr: - **Secondhand- und Wiederverkaufsoptionen.** Secondhandläden und Online-Marktplätze verzeichnen vor dem Fest mehr Besucher.

segments.src: - **Pets and children first.** Many households protect spending on kids' costumes while cutting back on their own.
segments.tr: - **Haustiere und Kinder zuerst.** Viele Haushalte schützen die Ausgaben für Kinderkostüme, während sie bei ihren eigenen Abstriche machen.

segments.src: Because costume trends often follow popular films, shows and games, retailers also face inventory risk.
segments.tr: Da Kostümtrends oft beliebten Filmen, Serien und Spielen folgen, stehen Einzelhändler auch vor einem Bestandsrisiko.

segments.src: A character that surges in popularity can sell out quickly, while a miss leaves shelves full of discounted stock.
segments.tr: Ein Charakter, dessen Beliebtheit sprunghaft ansteigt, kann schnell ausverkauft sein, während ein Flop die Regale voller rabattierter Ware zurücklässt.

segments.src: ## Decorations: A Measure of Confidence in the Home
segments.tr: ## Dekorationen: Ein Maßstab für das Vertrauen in das eigene Zuhause

segments.src: Decorations are the category that most clearly separates comfortable budgets from cautious ones.
segments.tr: Dekorationen sind die Kategorie, die komfortable Budgets am deutlichsten von vorsichtigen unterscheidet.

segments.src: Large inflatables, lighting and themed props can be expensive, and they are durable enough that many people choose to reuse last year's collection.
segments.tr: Große aufblasbare Figuren, Beleuchtung und Themen-Requisiten können teuer sein, und sie sind langlebig genug, dass sich viele Menschen dafür entscheiden, die Kollektion des Vorjahres wiederzuverwenden.

segments.src: When shoppers feel optimistic, they are more likely to add new pieces.
segments.tr: Wenn sich Käufer optimistisch fühlen, fügen sie eher neue Stücke hinzu.

segments.src: When they are uncertain, they tend to refresh a few items instead of buying a full display.
segments.tr: Wenn sie unsicher sind, frischen sie eher ein paar Artikel auf, anstatt eine komplette Dekoration zu kaufen.

segments.src: The growth of Halloween as a season rather than a single night has also shaped this category.
segments.tr: Das Wachstum von Halloween als saisonaler Zeitraum statt nur einer einzigen Nacht hat diese Kategorie ebenfalls geprägt.

segments.src: Retailers now stock seasonal merchandise earlier, and some consumers begin decorating weeks in advance.
segments.tr: Einzelhändler führen saisonale Waren mittlerweile früher, und einige Verbraucher beginnen Wochen im Voraus mit dem Dekorieren.

segments.src: That longer window gives households more time to compare prices, wait for sales and spread purchases across several paychecks.
segments.tr: Dieses längere Zeitfenster gibt den Haushalten mehr Zeit, Preise zu vergleichen, auf Sonderangebote zu warten und Einkäufe über mehrere Gehaltszahlungen zu verteilen.

segments.src: ## How Inflation Shapes the Basket
segments.tr: ## Wie Inflation den Warenkorb prägt

segments.src: Inflation does not simply raise the total; it changes the composition of what people buy.
segments.tr: Inflation erhöht nicht einfach nur die Gesamtsumme; sie verändert die Zusammensetzung dessen, was die Leute kaufen.

segments.src: A few dynamics are worth keeping in mind when reading any seasonal forecast:
segments.tr: Einige Dynamiken sollte man bei der Lektüre jeder Saisonprognose im Hinterkopf behalten:

segments.src: 1. **Nominal versus real spending.** A record dollar figure may reflect higher prices rather than more goods.
segments.tr: 1. **Nominale versus reale Ausgaben.** Ein Rekord-Dollarbetrag spiegelt möglicherweise eher höhere Preise als mehr gekaufte Güter wider.

segments.src: 2. **Trading down.** Shoppers often move toward lower-priced brands or retailers, which can shift where the money goes even if the total holds steady.
segments.tr: 2. **Down-Trading.** Käufer weichen häufig auf günstigere Marken oder Händler aus, was den Geldfluss verändern kann, selbst wenn die Gesamtsumme stabil bleibt.

segments.src: 3. **Uneven effects by income.** Higher-income households may maintain or increase spending, while lower-income households make visible cuts. Averages can hide that split.
segments.tr: 3. **Ungleiche Auswirkungen nach Einkommen.** Haushalte mit höherem Einkommen halten ihre Ausgaben möglicherweise bei oder erhöhen sie, während Haushalte mit geringerem Einkommen sichtbare Kürzungen vornehmen. Durchschnitte können diese Kluft verbergen.

segments.src: 4. **Credit and timing.** Some purchases are shifted to cards or to buy-now-pay-later options, which affects how comfortable spending actually is.
segments.tr: 4. **Kredit und Timing.** Einige Käufe werden auf Kreditkarten oder Jetzt-kaufen-später-zahlen-Optionen verlagert, was beeinflusst, wie komfortabel die Ausgaben tatsächlich sind.

segments.src: ## What to Watch for the Rest of the Season
segments.tr: ## Worauf man für den Rest der Saison achten sollte

segments.src: Halloween is only one data point, but it is an early one.
segments.tr: Halloween ist nur ein einzelner Datenpunkt, aber ein früher.

segments.src: Analysts will be looking at how final sales compare with the forecasts, whether promotional activity picks up in the last week, and how much merchandise is left over for post-holiday clearance.
segments.tr: Analysten werden beobachten, wie die endgültigen Verkäufe im Vergleich zu den Prognosen ausfallen, ob die Werbeaktivitäten in der letzten Woche zunehmen und wie viel Ware für den Räumungsverkauf nach den Feiertagen übrig bleibt.

segments.src: Heavy discounting after October 31 often suggests retailers misjudged demand, while thin clearance racks may indicate stronger-than-expected buying.
segments.tr: Starke Rabatte nach dem 31. Oktober deuten oft darauf hin, dass Händler die Nachfrage falsch eingeschätzt haben, während dünne Räumungsregale auf stärkere Käufe als erwartet hinweisen können.

segments.src: For households, the lesson is practical rather than predictive.
segments.tr: Für die Haushalte ist die Lektion eher praktischer als voraussagender Natur.

segments.src: Setting a firm budget in advance, comparing unit prices on candy, borrowing or reusing costumes and mixing new decorations with old ones can keep the holiday enjoyable without straining finances.
segments.tr: Das Fest kann angenehm gestaltet werden, ohne die Finanzen zu belasten, indem man im Voraus ein festes Budget festlegt, Stückpreise von Süßigkeiten vergleicht, Kostüme ausleiht oder wiederverwendet und neue Dekorationen mit alten mischt.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Das Fazit

segments.src: Halloween spending is not a perfect gauge of the economy, and forecasts are estimates that can be revised.
segments.tr: Die Halloween-Ausgaben sind kein perfekter Maßstab für die Wirtschaft, und Prognosen sind Schätzungen, die revidiert werden können.

segments.src: Still, the holiday offers a useful, human-scale look at how people are balancing small pleasures against rising costs.
segments.tr: Dennoch bietet der Feiertag einen nützlichen, menschlichen Blick darauf, wie die Menschen kleine Freuden gegen steigende Kosten abwägen.

segments.src: This year, the story is less about whether Americans will celebrate and more about how they choose to do it: carefully, selectively and, in many cases, creatively.
segments.tr: In diesem Jahr dreht sich die Geschichte weniger darum, ob Amerikaner feiern werden, sondern vielmehr darum, wie sie es tun: sorgfältig, wählerisch und in vielen Fällen kreativ.

segments.tr: Đồ trang trí là danh mục phân tách rõ ràng nhất giữa các ngân sách thoải mái và các ngân sách thận trọng.

segments.src: Large inflatables, lighting and themed props can be expensive, and they are durable enough that many people choose to reuse last year's collection.
segments.tr: Các vật bơm hơi lớn, đèn chiếu sáng và đạo cụ theo chủ đề có thể tốn kém, và chúng đủ bền để nhiều người chọn tái sử dụng bộ sưu tập của năm ngoái.

segments.src: When shoppers feel optimistic, they are more likely to add new pieces.
segments.tr: Khi người mua sắm cảm thấy lạc quan, họ có nhiều khả năng bổ sung các món mới hơn.

segments.src: When they are uncertain, they tend to refresh a few items instead of buying a full display.
segments.tr: Khi họ không chắc chắn, họ có xu hướng làm mới một vài món thay vì mua toàn bộ bộ trưng bày.

segments.src: The growth of Halloween as a season rather than a single night has also shaped this category.
segments.tr: Sự phát triển của Halloween như một mùa thay vì chỉ là một đêm duy nhất cũng đã định hình danh mục này.

segments.src: Retailers now stock seasonal merchandise earlier, and some consumers begin decorating weeks in advance.
segments.tr: Các nhà bán lẻ hiện dự trữ hàng hóa theo mùa sớm hơn và một số người tiêu dùng bắt đầu trang trí trước vài tuần.

segments.src: That longer window gives households more time to compare prices, wait for sales and spread purchases across several paychecks.
segments.tr: Khoảng thời gian dài hơn đó giúp các gia đình có nhiều thời gian hơn để so sánh giá cả, chờ giảm giá và trải đều các khoản mua sắm qua nhiều kỳ trả lương.

segments.src: ## How Inflation Shapes the Basket
segments.tr: ## Lạm phát định hình giỏ hàng như thế nào

segments.src: Inflation does not simply raise the total; it changes the composition of what people buy.
segments.tr: Lạm phát không chỉ đơn thuần làm tăng tổng số; nó làm thay đổi thành phần những gì mọi người mua.

segments.src: A few dynamics are worth keeping in mind when reading any seasonal forecast:
segments.tr: Một vài động lực cần ghi nhớ khi đọc bất kỳ dự báo theo mùa nào:

segments.src: 1. **Nominal versus real spending.** A record dollar figure may reflect higher prices rather than more goods.
segments.tr: 1. **Chi tiêu danh nghĩa so với chi tiêu thực tế.** Một con số đô la kỷ lục có thể phản ánh giá cao hơn thay vì nhiều hàng hóa hơn.

segments.src: 2. **Trading down.** Shoppers often move toward lower-priced brands or retailers, which can shift where the money goes even if the total holds steady.
segments.tr: 2. **Giao dịch giảm cấp.** Người mua sắm thường chuyển hướng sang các thương hiệu hoặc nhà bán lẻ có giá thấp hơn, điều này có thể thay đổi nơi tiền đi ngay cả khi tổng số không đổi.

segments.src: 3. **Uneven effects by income.** Higher-income households may maintain or increase spending, while lower-income households make visible cuts. Averages can hide that split.
segments.tr: 3. **Tác động không đồng đều theo thu nhập.** Các hộ gia đình có thu nhập cao hơn có thể duy trì hoặc tăng chi tiêu, trong khi các hộ gia đình có thu nhập thấp hơn thực hiện cắt giảm rõ rệt. Các mức trung bình có thể che giấu sự phân chia đó.

segments.src: 4. **Credit and timing.** Some purchases are shifted to cards or to buy-now-pay-later options, which affects how comfortable spending actually is.
segments.tr: 4. **Tín dụng và thời điểm.** Một số giao dịch mua được chuyển sang thẻ hoặc các tùy chọn mua trước trả sau, điều này ảnh hưởng đến mức độ thoải mái thực sự của chi tiêu.

segments.src: ## What to Watch for the Rest of the Season
segments.tr: ## Những điều cần chú ý trong phần còn lại của mùa

segments.src: Halloween is only one data point, but it is an early one.
segments.tr: Halloween chỉ là một điểm dữ liệu, nhưng nó là một điểm dữ liệu sớm.

segments.src: Analysts will be looking at how final sales compare with the forecasts, whether promotional activity picks up in the last week, and how much merchandise is left over for post-holiday clearance.
segments.tr: Các nhà phân tích sẽ xem xét doanh số bán hàng cuối cùng so sánh như thế nào với các dự báo, liệu hoạt động khuyến mại có tăng lên trong tuần cuối cùng hay không và còn lại bao nhiêu hàng hóa cho việc xả hàng sau kỳ nghỉ.

segments.src: Heavy discounting after October 31 often suggests retailers misjudged demand, while thin clearance racks may indicate stronger-than-expected buying.
segments.tr: Việc giảm giá mạnh sau ngày 31 tháng 10 thường cho thấy các nhà bán lẻ đã đánh giá sai nhu cầu, trong khi các kệ hàng xả mỏng có thể cho thấy hoạt động mua sắm mạnh hơn dự kiến.

segments.src: For households, the lesson is practical rather than predictive.
segments.tr: Đối với các hộ gia đình, bài học mang tính thiết thực hơn là mang tính dự đoán.

segments.src: Setting a firm budget in advance, comparing unit prices on candy, borrowing or reusing costumes and mixing new decorations with old ones can keep the holiday enjoyable without straining finances.
segments.tr: Lập ngân sách vững chắc trước, so sánh đơn giá kẹo, mượn hoặc tái sử dụng trang phục và kết hợp đồ trang trí mới với đồ cũ có thể giúp kỳ nghỉ thú vị mà không làm căng thẳng tài chính.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Điểm mấu chốt

segments.src: Halloween spending is not a perfect gauge of the economy, and forecasts are estimates that can be revised.
segments.tr: Chi tiêu cho Halloween không phải là thước đo hoàn hảo của nền kinh tế và các dự báo là ước tính có thể được sửa đổi.

segments.src: Still, the holiday offers a useful, human-scale look at how people are balancing small pleasures against rising costs.
segments.tr: Tuy nhiên, ngày lễ mang đến một cái nhìn hữu ích, ở quy mô con người về cách mọi người đang cân bằng những niềm vui nhỏ với chi phí đang tăng.

segments.src: This year, the story is less about whether Americans will celebrate and more about how they choose to do it: carefully, selectively and, in many cases, creatively.
segments.tr: Năm nay, câu chuyện ít nói về việc người Mỹ có ăn mừng hay không và nói nhiều hơn về cách họ chọn làm điều đó: cẩn thận, có chọn lọc và trong nhiều trường hợp, là sáng tạo.
